# ── Temperature Sensor ───────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── Fan Info ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum FanMode {

# ── Thermal Zone ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum PowerSupplyType {
    battery @0;
    mains @1;

    wireless @3;
    custom @4;
}

# ── Load Info ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct LoadInfo {
    load1 @0 :Float32;
    load5 @1 :Float32;

}

# ── Uptime Info ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── Logged-in User ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── System Time ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── Firmware Info ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    type @0 :Text;

}

# ── Chassis Info ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct ChassisInfo {
    manufacturer @0 :Text;
    model @1 :Text;
    serial @2 :Text;
    type @3 :ChassisType;
    assetTag @4 :Text;
}

enum ChassisType {
    desktop @0;
    laptop @1;
    server @2;
    tablet @3;
    phone @4;
    embedded @5;
    virtual @6;
    custom @7;
}

# ── Kernel Info ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct KernelInfo {
    name @0 :Text;
    version @1 :T.Version;
    release @2 :Text;
    architecture @3 :Text;
    buildDate @4 :Text;
    compiler @5 :Text;
    type @6 :Text;
    commandLine @7 :Text;
}

# ── Architecture Info ────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct ArchitectureInfo {
    cpuArch @0 :Text;
    byteOrder @1 :Text;
    addressSize @2 :UInt32;
    instructionSets @3 :List(Text);
    virtualization @4 :Bool;
    hypervisor @5 :Text;
}

# ── System Capability ────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct SystemCapability {
    name @0 :Text;
    available @1 :Bool;
    description @2 :Text;
    version @3 :Text;
}

# ── System Events ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface SystemSubscription {
    pull @0 () -> (events :List(SystemEvent));
    cancel @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
}

struct SystemEvent {
    union {
        hostnameChanged @0 :Text;
        timezoneChanged @1 :Text;
        temperatureAlert @2 :TemperatureAlertEvent;
        fanAlert @3 :FanAlertEvent;
        powerEvent @4 :PowerEvent;
        shutdownScheduled @5 :ShutdownScheduledEvent;
        shutdownCancelled @6 :Void;
        userLogin @7 :LoggedInUser;
        userLogout @8 :Text;
        custom @9 :Data;
    }
}

struct TemperatureAlertEvent {
    sensor @0 :Text;
    temperature @1 :Float32;
    threshold @2 :Float32;
    throttleActive @3 :Bool;
    timestamp @4 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct FanAlertEvent {
    fan @0 :Text;
    speed @1 :UInt32;
    maxSpeed @2 :UInt32;
    timestamp @3 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct PowerEvent {
    type @0 :PowerEventType;
    batteryLevel @1 :Float32;
    timestamp @2 :T.Timestamp;
}

enum PowerEventType {
    acConnected @0;
    acDisconnected @1;
    batteryLow @2;
    batteryCritical @3;
    batteryFull @4;
    chargerConnected @5;
    chargerDisconnected @6;
}

struct ShutdownScheduledEvent {
    action @0 :ShutdownAction;
    scheduledAt @1 :T.Timestamp;
    delay @2 :T.Duration;
    reason @3 :Text;
}

enum ShutdownAction {
    shutdown @0;
    reboot @1;
    suspend @2;
    hibernate @3;
}

Complete CLI Methods
Batch 0: Foundation
bashbash# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  BATCH 0: FOUNDATION
#  The universal primitives every domain uses
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── SHELL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# State
shell info                         → full shell state
shell mode                         → current mode
shell mode interactive             → switch to interactive mode
shell mode guided                  → switch to guided mode
shell mode script                  → switch to script mode

# Prompt
shell prompt                       → current prompt config
shell prompt set "❯ "              → set prompt character
shell prompt template "${cwd} ❯"   → set template
shell prompt git on                → show git branch
shell prompt battery on            → show battery
shell prompt duration on           → show command duration
shell prompt time on               → show time
shell prompt multiline             → enable multi-line prompt

# Aliases
aliases                            → list all aliases
alias ll "audio volume"            → set alias
alias rm "file trash"              → safe delete alias
unalias ll                         → remove alias

# Variables
vars                               → list all shell variables
var greeting "hello"               → set variable
echo $greeting                     → use variable
unset greeting                     → remove variable
export MY_VAR "value"              → export to environment
env                                → list environment variables
env HOME                           → get environment variable
env MY_VAR "value"                 → set environment variable

# History
history                            → show command history
history 20                         → show last 20 entries
history search "audio"             → search history
history clear                      → clear history
history pin 42                     → pin history entry
history export ~/history.txt       → export history
history --format json              → JSON output

# Jobs
jobs                               → list background jobs
fg 1                               → bring job 1 to foreground
bg 1                               → send job 1 to background
cancel 1                           → cancel job 1
wait 1                             → wait for job 1

# Undo
undo                               → undo last command
redo                               → redo last undone command
undo-stack                         → show undo stack
undoable                           → check if last command is undoable

# Bookmarks
bookmarks                          → list bookmarks
bookmark save "audio volume 75" --label "louder"
bookmark run 3                     → run bookmark #3
bookmark remove 3                  → remove bookmark

# Watchers
watchers                           → list active watchers
watcher cancel 3                   → cancel watcher #3

# Snapshots
snapshot save "before-tweak"       → save shell state
snapshot restore "before-tweak"    → restore shell state
snapshots                          → list snapshots
snapshot delete "before-tweak"     → delete snapshot

# Completion
completions audio                  → show completions for "audio"
completions @battery               → show selector completions
completions window 3               → show completions for "window 3"

# Guided mode
guide                              → enter guided mode (main menu)
guide audio                        → guided audio setup
guide network                      → guided network setup
guide display                      → guided display setup
guide security                     → guided security setup
guide troubleshoot                 → guided troubleshooting
tutorial                           → list all tutorials
tutorial audio                     → start audio tutorial
cheat-sheet                        → commonly used commands

# Natural language
ask "what's using my battery?"     → natural language query
ask "turn up the volume"           → natural language action
ask "why is my laptop slow?"       → natural language diagnosis
ask "connect to my wifi"           → natural language connection
ask "show me my schedule today"    → natural language calendar
ask --format toml "list services"  → NL query with format override

# Script
script run setup.smart             → run script
script validate setup.smart        → validate without running
script context                     → current script context
script debug setup.smart           → run with debug output

# ── CLI ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Configuration
cli config                         → show all CLI config
cli config format toml             → set default output format
cli config format human            → set default back to human
cli config theme midnight          → set theme
cli config verbosity verbose       → set verbosity
cli config confirm on              → confirm destructive ops
cli config ai on                   → enable AI-assisted interpretation
cli config autocorrect on          → enable auto-correction
cli config tips on                 → show tips on startup
cli config page-limit 50           → items per page

# Domains
domains                            → list all available domains
domain audio                       → show domain info (commands, schema version)
domain audio help                  → full help for audio domain
domain audio syntax                → syntax reference for audio
domain audio tutorial              → tutorial for audio domain
help audio volume                  → help for specific command

# Extensions
extensions                         → list CLI extensions
extension install "smart-weather"  → install extension
extension remove "smart-weather"   → remove extension
extension enable "smart-weather"   → enable extension
extension disable "smart-weather"  → disable extension

# Themes
themes                             → list available themes
theme set midnight                 → set active theme
theme current                      → show current theme

# Diagnostics
cli diagnose                       → run CLI self-diagnostics
cli ping                           → check protocol connectivity
cli version                        → CLI version and build info

# Remote hosts
remote                             → list configured remote hosts
remote add server1 192.168.1.5     → add remote host
remote remove server1              → remove remote host
remote connect server1             → connect to remote host

# Suggestions
suggest                            → contextual suggestions
suggest "I want to"                → suggestions for intent
suggest troubleshoot               → troubleshooting suggestions

# Hybrid commands
hybrid                             → list all hybrid commands
hybrid help why-slow               → help for a hybrid command

# ── CAPABILITY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

capabilities                       → list held capabilities
capability <handle> info           → inspect specific capability
capability check audio read        → check if access is allowed
capability sets                    → list capability sets
capability templates               → list available templates
capability <handle> audit          → audit trail for capability
capability scopes                  → list active capability scopes

# ── ABI ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

abi list                           → list all supported ABIs

abi diff <from> <to>               → diff two ABI versions
abi session                        → show negotiation session
abi registry                       → ABI registry
abi pin <version>                  → pin ABI version
abi unpin <version>                → unpin ABI version

# Operations

# List

processes sort memory desc         → sorted by memory

process 1842 executable            → executable path

process 1842 nice                  → nice value

trend disk --duration 7d           → disk trend

# ── BOOT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

boot info                          → full boot info
boot method                        → boot method
boot firmware                      → firmware info
boot bootloader                    → bootloader info
boot command-line                  → kernel command line
boot duration                      → boot duration
boot parameters                    → boot parameters
boot parameters set timeout 5      → set boot timeout
boot parameters set menu on        → show boot menu
boot parameters set debug on       → debug mode
boot entries                       → list boot entries
boot entries default               → default boot entry
boot entries default set "smart-2.0" → set default
boot entries next set "smart-2.1"  → one-shot next boot
boot log                           → boot log
boot log --phase kernel            → kernel phase logs
boot log --level error             → error logs
boot splash                        → boot splash config
boot splash set theme "midnight"   → set splash theme
boot recovery                      → recovery mode status
boot recovery enable               → enable recovery mode
boot recovery disable              → disable recovery mode
boot secure-boot                   → secure boot status
boot secure-boot keys              → secure boot keys
boot attempts                      → boot attempt counters
boot mark-successful               → mark boot successful

Edge Cases (Comprehensive)
texttext╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  EDGE CASES — Users, developers, and AI must always be able to win      ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                          ║
║  SHELL                                                                   ║
║  ├─ Undo after 50 commands                                               ║
║  │  → Bounded by maxUndoLevels. Oldest entries evicted.                  ║
║  │  → "Undo stack full (max 50). Oldest entry evicted."                 ║
║  ├─ Undo of an undo (redo)                                               ║
║  │  → Works. Redo stack is separate. "Redo: audio volume 75"            ║
║  ├─ Script running when user exits shell                                 ║
║  │  → Background job survives. "Job 3 continues in background."         ║
║  ├─ Natural language interpreted wrong                                   ║
║  │  → Always requires confirmation first. Shows alternatives.            ║
║  │  → "I think you mean X. Also possible: Y, Z. Execute X? [Y/n]"      ║
║  ├─ Natural language with low confidence                                 ║
║  │  → "I'm not sure what you mean. Did you mean: 1) X, 2) Y, 3) Z"    ║
║  ├─ Guided mode user cancels mid-flow                                    ║
║  │  → Clean state. No partial operations. "Guide cancelled."            ║
║  ├─ Guided mode with no matching domain                                  ║
║  │  → "Domain 'xyz' not found. Available: [list]. Try: guide"           ║
║  ├─ Tab completion with 10,000 results                                   ║
║  │  → Paginated with filter. "Showing 1-50 of 10,000. Type to filter." ║
║  ├─ History grows to 1M entries                                          ║
║  │  → Automatic rotation. Pinned entries preserved.                      ║
║  │  → "History rotated. 42 pinned entries preserved."                    ║
║  ├─ Bookmark references a removed service                                ║
║  │  → "Service 'xyz' not found. It may have been removed."              ║
║  │  → Suggestion: "Run 'services' to see available services."            ║
║  ├─ Snapshot with remote variables                                       ║
║  │  → Snapshot includes host identifier. Restore warns if host changed.  ║
║  ├─ Two shells editing same variable                                     ║
║  │  → Last-write-wins with warning: "Variable 'x' was changed by        ║
║  │     another shell (PID 5678) 2 seconds ago."                         ║
║  ├─ Alias creates circular reference                                     ║
║  │  → Detected on creation. "Circular alias detected: a → b → a."       ║
║  ├─ Bookmark command that was an alias (alias deleted later)             ║
║  │  → Bookmark stores expanded command at save time. Survives alias rm.  ║
║  ├─ Natural language with no AI backend                                  ║
║  │  → "AI interpretation not available. Try: help [domain]"              ║
║  │  → Falls back to keyword matching for basic queries.                  ║
║  ├─ Script with syntax error on line 500                                 ║
║  │  → Shows line 500, column 12, error, and suggestion. Not a wall.     ║
║  ├─ Shell in voice mode with ambiguous pronunciation                     ║
║  │  → "Did you say 'audio' or 'video'? 1) audio, 2) video"             ║
║  └─ Snapshot restore when dependencies have changed                      ║
║     → "Service 'nginx' referenced in snapshot no longer exists."         ║
║     → "Variables and aliases restored. Service references skipped."       ║
║                                                                          ║
║  SYSTEM                                                                  ║
║  ├─ Set hostname with special characters                                 ║
║  │  → Validated. Only [a-z0-9-] allowed. "Invalid character: @"         ║
║  │  → Suggestion: "Try: system hostname 'workstation'"                  ║
║  ├─ DIMM info not available (VM)                                         ║
║  │  → Shows "N/A" gracefully. No crash. No blank field.                 ║
║  ├─ GPU temp sensor missing                                              ║
║  │  → Shows available sensors, marks missing as "not available".         ║
║  ├─ Fan control not supported                                            ║
║  │  → "Fan control not supported on this hardware."                      ║
║  │  → "Fans are running in automatic mode (managed by firmware)."        ║
║  ├─ Set timezone to invalid value                                        ║
║  │  → "Timezone 'xyz' not found."                                       ║
║  │  → Suggestions: "Did you mean: Europe/Berlin, America/New_York?"     ║
║  ├─ Shutdown during active capability delegation                         ║
║  │  → Capabilities cleaned up. Delegation targets notified.              ║
║  │  → "Shutdown: cleaning up 3 active delegations..."                    ║
║  ├─ Shutdown during service starting                                     ║
║  │  → Graceful stop with timeout. "Waiting for nginx (10s timeout)..."  ║
║  ├─ Multiple power supply (UPS + battery + mains)                        ║
║  │  → Shows all independently. Each with own status.                     ║
║  ├─ NTP server unreachable                                               ║
║  │  → Falls back to hardware clock. Warning: "NTP unreachable.          ║
║  │     Using hardware clock. Drift may accumulate."                      ║
║  ├─ System time set backwards                                            ║
║  │  → Warns about cron/timer implications. Requires --force.             ║
║  │  → "Setting time backwards may affect 3 timers and 1 cron job."      ║
║  ├─ Battery reports > 100%                                               ║
║  │  → Clamped to 100%. Warning: "Battery calibration may be off."       ║
║  ├─ Temperature sensor reports 0°C or negative                           ║
║  │  → Shows value. If below ambient, marks as "sensor may be faulty".   ║
║  ├─ Disk health at 0%                                                    ║
║  │  → CRITICAL alert. "Disk sda is failing. Back up immediately."       ║
║  │  → "Run: predict disk" for detailed analysis.                        ║
║  └─ Chassis info not available (custom hardware)                         ║
║     → Shows "Unknown" for missing fields. Other fields still shown.      ║
║                                                                          ║
║  PROCESS                                                                 ║
║  ├─ Zombie process                                                       ║
║  │  → Can query exit status before reaping.                              ║
║  │  → "Process 1842 is a zombie (exit code: 0, parent: PID 1000)."      ║
║  │  → "Zombie processes cannot be killed. Wait for parent to reap."      ║
║  ├─ Process disappears during query                                      ║
║  │  → "Process 1842 no longer exists. It may have exited."               ║
║  ├─ Kill zombie                                                          ║
║  │  → "Cannot kill zombie process 1842. Zombie processes have            ║
║  │     already exited and are waiting for their parent to reap them."    ║
║  │  → "Parent is PID 1000 (init). Zombie will be reaped automatically." ║
║  ├─ Process in multiple cgroups                                          ║
║  │  → Shows all cgroups, primary listed first.                           ║
║  │  → "Cgroups: app.slice (primary), custom.slice"                      ║
║  ├─ Process tree is 50 levels deep                                       ║
║  │  → Paginated. Collapsible. "Showing 5 levels. Expand with +."        ║
║  ├─ Process with 10,000 open files                                       ║
║  │  → Paginated with search. "files where path contains '.log'"         ║
║  ├─ Set nice on RT process                                               ║
║  │  → "Nice applies to fair-scheduled processes. Process 1842 uses      ║
║  │     FIFO scheduling. Use 'scheduler policy' to change."              ║
║  ├─ Process in container namespace                                       ║
║  │  → Shows both container PID and host PID.                             ║
║  │  → "PID 42 (host), Container PID 1 (container 'web')"                ║
║  ├─ Resource exceeded for critical process                               ║
║  │  → Auto-alert created. Action depends on cgroup policy.               ║
║  ├─ Renice with value outside range                                      ║
║  │  → "Nice value must be between -20 and 19. Got: 25."                 ║
║  │  → "Try: process 1842 nice 19"                                       ║
║  ├─ Process tree has circular parent reference                            ║
║  │  → Detected and broken. "Circular reference detected at PID 500."    ║
║  └─ Suspend a process that's already suspended                           ║
║     → "Process 1842 is already stopped." (idempotent, no error)          ║
║                                                                          ║
║  INIT / SERVICES                                                         ║
║  ├─ Circular dependency in services                                      ║
║  │  → Detected and reported. "Circular dependency: A → B → C → A"       ║
║  │  → "Services will be started in order: A, B, C (cycle broken at C)." ║
║  ├─ Service fails to start                                               ║
║  │  → Retry with backoff. Then failed state. Clear error + remediation.  ║
║  ├─ Socket activation during high load                                   ║
║  │  → Connection queue manages. "Queue depth: 128/1024."                 ║
║  ├─ Timer missed (system was suspended)                                  ║
║  │  → Catches up if persistent. Logs as missed if not.                   ║
║  ├─ Emergency mode entered                                               ║
║  │  → Minimal services only. Clear indication in prompt and status.      ║
║  ├─ Service masked but dependency requires it                            ║
║  │  → "Service 'nginx' requires 'network', but 'network' is masked."   ║
║  │  → "Run: service network unmask" to resolve.                         ║
║  ├─ Service log buffer full                                              ║
║  │  → Oldest rotated. "Log buffer rotated. Last 10,000 entries kept."   ║
║  ├─ Timer fires during shutdown                                          ║
║  │  → Skipped. Logged as missed. "Timer 'backup' skipped (shutting down)"║
║  ├─ Boot entry with missing kernel                                       ║
║  │  → "Boot entry 'smart-2.0' is not bootable. Kernel not found."       ║
║  │  → "Run: boot entries" to see available entries.                      ║
║  ├─ Service restart with different PID                                   ║
║  │  → Normal. "Service nginx restarted. PID: 1842 → 3847."              ║
║  ├─ Service dependency chain 20 levels deep                              ║
║  │  → Shows full tree. Collapsible. "Deep dependency chain detected."   ║
║  └─ Timer with past-due one-shot                                         ║

║     → "The one-shot timer has already passed. It will not trigger again."║
║                                                                          ║
║  KERNEL                                                                  ║
║  ├─ Kernel introspect during high load                                   ║

║  ├─ IRQ not available                                                    ║

║  ├─ Port I/O on VM                                                       ║

║  ├─ Kernel swap during active processes                                  ║

║  │  → Clean timeout result. "Wait timed out after 30s. No signal         ║
║  │     received."                                                         ║
║  └─ Real-time signal with large payload                                  ║
║     → Queue limits enforced. "Payload exceeds maximum (4096 bytes)."      ║
║                                                                          ║
║  DIAGNOSTICS                                                             ║
║  ├─ Health check takes too long                                          ║
║  │  → Timeout with partial results. "Check 'disk-health' timed out       ║
║  │     after 30s. Partial results shown."                                ║
║  ├─ Alert threshold set to unreachable value                             ║
║  │  → Warning on configure. "Warning threshold 200% is above maximum     ║
║  │     possible value (100%). This alert will never trigger."             ║
║  ├─ Profile with no data                                                 ║
║  │  → "No measurable activity during profile (30s)."                     ║
║  │  → "Try: profile start --target [process] to focus on a process."    ║
║  ├─ Self-test modifies state                                             ║
║  │  → Destructive tests require confirmation. "This test will write      ║
║  │     100MB to disk. Confirm? [Y/n]"                                    ║
║  ├─ Prediction with low confidence                                       ║
║  │  → "Prediction confidence: 23%. Monitor recommended."                 ║
║  │  → "Run: trend disk --duration 30d for more data."                    ║
║  ├─ Report generation during system stress                               ║
║  │  → Deferred or degraded. "System under heavy load. Report will be     ║
║  │     generated with reduced detail."                                    ║
║  ├─ Multiple simultaneous profiles                                       ║
║  │  → Allowed. Each tracked independently.                               ║
║  │  → "Profile 2 started. (Profile 1 is also running.)"                 ║
║  └─ Alert acknowledged by another user                                   ║
║     → "Alert 42 was already acknowledged by 'admin' at 14:30."           ║
║                                                                          ║
║  BOOT                                                                    ║
║  ├─ Boot entry kernel not found                                          ║
║  │  → "Boot entry 'smart-2.0' is not bootable. Kernel not found at      ║
║  │     /boot/vmlinuz-smart-2.0."                                         ║
║  │  → "Run: boot entries to see available entries."                      ║
║  ├─ Secure boot with unsigned kernel                                     ║
║  │  → "Blocked: Kernel 'custom-kernel' is not signed. Secure boot        ║

║  │  → "Disable secure boot or sign the kernel. Run: boot secure-boot"   ║
║  ├─ Set next boot entry that doesn't exist                               ║
║  │  → "Boot entry 'xyz' not found. Available: smart-2.0, smart-2.1,     ║

║  ├─ Boot splash with missing theme                                       ║
║  │  → Falls back to text mode. "Theme 'midnight' not found.              ║
║  │     Falling back to text boot."                                        ║
║  ├─ Recovery mode entered automatically (crash recovery)                  ║
║  │  → Logged. "Entered recovery mode due to boot failure (crash)."       ║
║  │  → "Last boot failed at phase: services. Failed service: nginx."      ║
║  ├─ Boot parameters with invalid kernel args                             ║

║                                                                          ║
║  CAPABILITY                                                              ║
║  ├─ Delegate more operations than parent has                             ║

║  ├─ "why slow" during kernel swap                                        ║

║  │  → "Run: trend memory --duration 7d to collect data."                 ║
║  └─ Hybrid command with --format                                         ║
║     → Works like any other command. "why slow --format toml"             ║
║     → Structured data in requested format.                                ║
║                                                                          ║
║  FORMAT & OUTPUT                                                         ║
║  ├─ --format on a command with no structured data                        ║
║  │  → "Command 'undo' has no structured data to format."                 ║
║  │  → Falls back to human output.                                        ║
║  ├─ --format capnp on human terminal                                     ║
║  │  → Binary output to terminal. Warning: "Binary output to terminal.   ║
║  │     Use: command --capnp > output.capnp"                              ║
║  ├─ --format csv on nested data                                          ║
║  │  → Flattened with dot notation. "cpu.model, cpu.cores, memory.total" ║
║  ├─ --format toml on list output                                         ║
║  │  → TOML array of tables. Each item is a [[section]].                  ║
║  ├─ --format md on tree output                                           ║
║  │  → Indented markdown list. Or table if flat.                          ║
║  ├─ --format raw on complex output                                       ║
║  │  → Just the primary value. "system hostname --raw → thinkpad"         ║
║  └─ Pipe to file with --format                                           ║
║     → Smart detection. "system info --json > info.json" works.           ║
║     → "Output written to info.json (12.4 KB)"                            ║
║                                                                          ║
║  REMOTE                                                                  ║
║  ├─ Remote host unreachable                                              ║
║  │  → "Host 'server1' (192.168.1.5) unreachable. Last seen: 2h ago."   ║
║  │  → "Check: remote connect server1"                                    ║
║  ├─ Remote host schema version mismatch                                  ║
║  │  → "Schema version mismatch with server1. Local: 0.3.0, Remote: 0.2.0"║
║  │  → "Some commands may not be available on remote host."               ║
║  ├─ Remote command with different default format                         ║
║  │  → Format applies to local output. Remote always returns capnp.       ║
║  └─ Remote host during network partition                                 ║
║     → "Connection to server1 lost. 3 commands queued."                   ║
║     → "Reconnect: remote connect server1"                                ║
║                                                                          ║
║  AI-ASSISTED                                                             ║
║  ├─ "ask" with AI backend offline                                        ║
║  │  → "AI interpretation not available. Using keyword matching."         ║
║  │  → Basic queries still work (volume, battery, etc).                   ║
║  ├─ "ask" with ambiguous request                                         ║
║  │  → Shows top 3 interpretations with confidence scores.                ║
║  │  → "1) Set volume to 80% (confidence: 92%)"                          ║
║  │  → "2) Show volume info (confidence: 45%)"                           ║
║  ├─ "ask" requesting destructive action                                  ║
║  │  → Always requires confirmation. "This will delete 3 files.           ║
║  │     Confirm? [Y/n]"                                                    ║
║  └─ "ask" in non-English language                                        ║
║     → If supported: interprets and responds in same language.            ║
║     → If not: "Language not supported. Try English."                     ║

# ═══ CHEAT SHEET ═══

$ cheat-sheet
  ── Quick Reference ──────────────────────────────

  System
    system info                    Full system info
    system cpu temperature         CPU temperature
    system hostname "name"         Set hostname
    system suspend                 Suspend
    system shutdown                Shutdown

  Processes
    processes                      List all
    process 1842 info              Full process info
    process 1842 kill              Kill process
    processes where cpu > 50       Filter

  Services
    services                       List all
    service nginx info             Full service info
    service nginx restart          Restart
    service nginx logs             View logs

  Kernel
    kernel info                    Full kernel info
    kernel introspect              Introspect
    kernel caps                    Capabilities

  Scheduler
    scheduler info                 Full scheduler info
    scheduler affinity 1842 0,1    Set affinity
    scheduler topology             CPU topology

  Health & Diagnostics
    health                         System health
    alerts                         Active alerts
    profile                        Performance snapshot
    predict                        Failure predictions

  Hybrid

using T = import "types.capnp";

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Compositor — layer management, effects, vsync, rendering pipeline
#
# The compositor owns what appears on screen. Layers, effects,
# animations, vsync, and the rendering pipeline. Backend-agnostic:
# Wayland, custom compositor, or anything else. The protocol
# describes what the compositor exposes to the shell and apps.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface CompositorService {
    # State
    getInfo @0 () -> (info :CompositorInfo);

    # Layers
    listLayers @1 () -> (layers :List(LayerInfo));
    getLayer @2 (layerId :UInt32) -> (layer :LayerInfo);
    createLayer @3 (config :LayerConfig) -> (layerId :UInt32);
    destroyLayer @4 (layerId :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;
    setLayerOrder @5 (layerId :UInt32, zOrder :Int32) -> T.VoidResult;
    setLayerVisibility @6 (layerId :UInt32, visible :Bool) -> T.VoidResult;
    setLayerOpacity @7 (layerId :UInt32, opacity :Float32) -> T.VoidResult;
    setLayerPosition @8 (layerId :UInt32, x :Int32, y :Int32) -> T.VoidResult;
    setLayerSize @9 (layerId :UInt32, width :UInt32, height :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Effects
    listEffects @10 () -> (effects :List(EffectInfo));
    enableEffect @11 (name :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    disableEffect @12 (name :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    configureEffect @13 (name :Text, config :EffectConfig) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Vsync
    getVsync @14 () -> (vsync :VsyncInfo);
    setVsyncMode @15 (mode :VsyncMode) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Rendering
    getRenderStats @16 () -> (stats :RenderStats);
    setRenderScale @17 (scale :Float32) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Screenshot / Recording
    screenshot @18 (region :T.Rect) -> (image :Data);
    startRecording @19 (config :RecordingConfig) -> (recordingId :UInt64);
    stopRecording @20 (recordingId :UInt64) -> (path :Text);

    # Events
    subscribe @21 () -> (subscription :CompositorSubscription);
}

struct CompositorInfo {
    name @0 :Text;
    version @1 :T.Version;
    renderer @2 :Text;           # "OpenGL", "Vulkan", "software"
    layerCount @3 :UInt32;
    fps @4 :Float32;
    frameTime @5 :Float32;       # ms
    vsync @6 :VsyncMode;
    renderScale @7 :Float32;
    memoryUsed @8 :UInt64;
    gpuAccelerated @9 :Bool;
}

struct LayerInfo {
    id @0 :UInt32;
    name @1 :Text;
    zOrder @2 :Int32;
    visible @3 :Bool;
    opacity @4 :Float32;
    bounds @5 :T.Rect;
    owner @6 :Text;              # App or service owning this layer
    damageRegion @7 :T.Rect;
    bufferFormat @8 :Text;
}

struct LayerConfig {
    name @0 :Text;
    width @1 :UInt32;
    height @2 :UInt32;
    zOrder @3 :Int32;
    opacity @4 :Float32;
    visible @5 :Bool;
    bufferFormat @6 :Text;
}

struct EffectInfo {
    name @0 :Text;
    description @1 :Text;
    enabled @2 :Bool;
    # Performance impact (0=none, 1=heavy).
    performanceCost @3 :Float32;
    configurable @4 :Bool;
    parameters @5 :List(EffectParameter);
}

struct EffectParameter {
    name @0 :Text;
    type @1 :Text;
    currentValue @2 :Text;
    defaultValue @3 :Text;
    minValue @4 :Text;
    maxValue @5 :Text;
}

struct EffectConfig {
    parameters @0 :T.StringMap;
}

enum VsyncMode {
    off @0;
    on @1;
    adaptive @2;     # Only vsync when above refresh rate
    mailbox @3;      # Triple buffering
    custom @4;
}

struct VsyncInfo {
    mode @0 :VsyncMode;
    refreshRate @1 :Float32;     # Hz
    actualFps @2 :Float32;
    frameTimeMs @3 :Float32;
    # Whether we're hitting the target.
    onTarget @4 :Bool;
    droppedFrames @5 :UInt64;
}

struct RenderStats {
    fps @0 :Float32;
    frameTimeMs @1 :Float32;
    gpuTimeMs @2 :Float32;
    cpuTimeMs @3 :Float32;
    droppedFrames @4 :UInt64;
    totalFrames @5 :UInt64;
    vramUsed @6 :UInt64;
    vramTotal @7 :UInt64;
    # Frame time percentiles.
    p50 @8 :Float32;
    p95 @9 :Float32;
    p99 @10 :Float32;
}

struct RecordingConfig {
    # Output file path.
    path @0 :Text;
    # Region to record (empty = full screen).
    region @1 :T.Rect;
    # Frame rate.
    fps @2 :UInt32;
    # Codec ("h264", "vp9", "av1").
    codec @3 :Text;
    # Quality (0-100).
    quality @4 :UInt32;
    # Include cursor.
    includeCursor @5 :Bool;
    # Include audio.
    includeAudio @6 :Bool;
}

interface CompositorSubscription {
    pull @0 () -> (events :List(CompositorEvent));
    cancel @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
}

struct CompositorEvent {
    union {
        layerCreated @0 :LayerInfo;
        layerDestroyed @1 :UInt32;
        layerChanged @2 :LayerInfo;
        fpsChanged @3 :Float32;
        effectChanged @4 :EffectInfo;
        gpuReset @5 :Void;
        custom @6 :Data;
    }
}

using T = import "types.capnp";

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Window Manager — window management, tiling, focus, decorations,
#                  workspaces, and window policies
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface WindowManagerService {
    # Windows
    listWindows @0 (filter :WindowFilter) -> (windows :List(WindowInfo));
    getWindow @1 (windowId :T.WindowId) -> (window :WindowInfo);

    # Window actions
    focus @2 (windowId :T.WindowId) -> T.VoidResult;
    close @3 (windowId :T.WindowId) -> T.VoidResult;
    minimize @4 (windowId :T.WindowId) -> T.VoidResult;
    maximize @5 (windowId :T.WindowId) -> T.VoidResult;
    restore @6 (windowId :T.WindowId) -> T.VoidResult;
    fullscreen @7 (windowId :T.WindowId) -> T.VoidResult;
    move @8 (windowId :T.WindowId, x :Int32, y :Int32) -> T.VoidResult;
    resize @9 (windowId :T.WindowId, width :UInt32, height :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;
    setAlwaysOnTop @10 (windowId :T.WindowId, always :Bool) -> T.VoidResult;
    setDecorations @11 (windowId :T.WindowId, decorations :Bool) -> T.VoidResult;
    setOpacity @12 (windowId :T.WindowId, opacity :Float32) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Snapping / Tiling
    snap @13 (windowId :T.WindowId, position :SnapPosition) -> T.VoidResult;
    tile @14 (windowIds :List(T.WindowId), layout :TileLayout) -> T.VoidResult;
    untile @15 (windowId :T.WindowId) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Focus
    getFocused @16 () -> (windowId :T.WindowId);
    getFocusPolicy @17 () -> (policy :FocusPolicy);
    setFocusPolicy @18 (policy :FocusPolicy) -> T.VoidResult;
    focusNext @19 () -> T.VoidResult;
    focusPrevious @20 () -> T.VoidResult;

    # Workspaces
    listWorkspaces @21 () -> (workspaces :List(WorkspaceInfo));
    getActiveWorkspace @22 () -> (workspace :WorkspaceInfo);
    switchWorkspace @23 (workspaceId :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;
    createWorkspace @24 (name :Text) -> (workspaceId :UInt32);
    deleteWorkspace @25 (workspaceId :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;
    moveToWorkspace @26 (windowId :T.WindowId, workspaceId :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;
    moveToNextWorkspace @27 (windowId :T.WindowId) -> T.VoidResult;
    moveToPreviousWorkspace @28 (windowId :T.WindowId) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Bulk operations
    minimizeAll @29 () -> T.VoidResult;
    restoreAll @30 () -> T.VoidResult;
    closeAll @31 (appId :T.AppId) -> T.VoidResult;
    focusApp @32 (appId :T.AppId) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Policies
    getTilingPolicy @33 () -> (policy :TilingPolicy);
    setTilingPolicy @34 (policy :TilingPolicy) -> T.VoidResult;
    getDecorationPolicy @35 () -> (policy :DecorationPolicy);
    setDecorationPolicy @36 (policy :DecorationPolicy) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Events
    subscribe @37 (filter :WindowEventFilter) -> (subscription :WindowSubscription);
}

struct WindowInfo {
    id @0 :T.WindowId;
    title @1 :Text;
    appId @2 :T.AppId;
    appName @3 :Text;
    state @4 :WindowState;
    bounds @5 :T.Rect;
    # Content area (excluding decorations).
    contentBounds @6 :T.Rect;
    workspace @7 :UInt32;
    focused @8 :Bool;
    minimized @9 :Bool;
    maximized @10 :Bool;
    fullscreen @11 :Bool;
    alwaysOnTop @12 :Bool;
    opacity @13 :Float32;
    decorations @14 :Bool;
    # Output/monitor this window is on.
    output @15 :Text;
    # PID of owning process.
    pid @16 :T.ProcessId;
    # Whether this window is tiled.
    tiled @17 :Bool;
    # Snap position (if snapped).
    snapPosition @18 :SnapPosition;
    # Window type.
    type @19 :WindowType;
    # When the window was created.
    createdAt @20 :T.Timestamp;
    # When the window was last focused.
    lastFocused @21 :T.Timestamp;
}

enum WindowState {
    normal @0;
    minimized @1;
    maximized @2;
    fullscreen @3;
    tiled @4;
    snapped @5;
    hidden @6;
    closing @7;
}

enum WindowType {
    normal @0;
    dialog @1;
    popup @2;
    tooltip @3;
    splash @4;
    utility @5;
    menu @6;
    toolbar @7;
    notification @8;
    custom @9;
}

enum SnapPosition {
    left @0;
    right @1;
    top @2;
    bottom @3;
    topLeft @4;
    topRight @5;
    bottomLeft @6;
    bottomRight @7;
    maximize @8;
    center @9;
}

enum TileLayout {
    horizontal @0;
    vertical @1;
    grid @2;
    fibonacci @3;
    monocle @4;        # One window visible at a time
    custom @5;
}

struct WindowFilter {
    appId @0 :T.AppId;
    state @1 :WindowState;
    workspace @2 :UInt32;
    output @3 :Text;
    focused @4 :T.BoolFilter;
    minimized @5 :T.BoolFilter;
    pattern @6 :Text;        # Match title substring
    type @7 :WindowType;
}

struct FocusPolicy {
    mode @0 :FocusMode;
    # Whether clicking a window focuses it.
    clickToFocus @1 :Bool;
    # Focus follows mouse.
    focusFollowsMouse @2 :Bool;
    # Whether new windows auto-focus.
    autoFocusNew @3 :Bool;
    # Whether raising a window focuses it.
    raiseOnFocus @4 :Bool;
    # Delay before focus-follows-mouse activates (ms).
    focusDelay @5 :UInt32;
}

enum FocusMode {
    click @0;
    followMouse @1;
    sloppy @2;         # Focus on enter, don't unfocus on leave
    custom @3;
}

struct TilingPolicy {
    enabled @0 :Bool;
    # Default layout.
    defaultLayout @1 :TileLayout;
    # Gaps between windows (pixels).
    gap @2 :UInt32;
    # Whether to auto-tile new windows.
    autoTile @3 :Bool;
    # Which apps to exclude from tiling.
    excludedApps @4 :List(Text);
    # Master area ratio (0.0-1.0).
    masterRatio @5 :Float32;
    # Number of windows in master area.
    masterCount @6 :UInt32;
}

struct DecorationPolicy {
    # Default decoration mode.
    mode @0 :DecorationMode;
    # Apps excluded from decorations.
    excludedApps @1 :List(Text);
    # Title bar height (pixels).
    titleBarHeight @2 :UInt32;
    # Border width (pixels).
    borderWidth @3 :UInt32;
    # Border color.
    borderColor @4 :Text;
    # Active border color.
    activeBorderColor @5 :Text;
    # Corner radius (pixels).
    cornerRadius @6 :UInt32;
}

enum DecorationMode {
    all @0;
    minimal @1;
    none @2;
    custom @3;
}

struct WorkspaceInfo {
    id @0 :UInt32;
    name @1 :Text;
    active @2 :Bool;
    windowCount @3 :UInt32;
    # Windows on this workspace.
    windows @4 :List(T.WindowId);
    # Output this workspace is on.
    output @5 :Text;
}

struct WindowEventFilter {
    windowIds @0 :List(T.WindowId);
    eventTypes @1 :List(WindowEventType);
    appIds @2 :List(T.AppId);
}

enum WindowEventType {
    created @0;
    closed @1;
    focused @2;
    unfocused @3;
    moved @4;
    resized @5;
    stateChanged @6;
    titleChanged @7;
    workspaceChanged @8;
    custom @9;
}

interface WindowSubscription {
    pull @0 () -> (events :List(WindowEvent));
    cancel @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
}

struct WindowEvent {
    union {
        created @0 :WindowInfo;
        closed @1 :T.WindowId;
        focused @2 :T.WindowId;
        unfocused @3 :T.WindowId;
        moved @4 :WindowMoveEvent;
        resized @5 :WindowResizeEvent;
        stateChanged @6 :WindowStateChangedEvent;
        titleChanged @7 :WindowTitleChangedEvent;
        workspaceChanged @8 :WindowWorkspaceChangedEvent;
        custom @9 :Data;
    }
}

struct WindowMoveEvent {
    windowId @0 :T.WindowId;
    previous @1 :T.Rect;
    current @2 :T.Rect;
    timestamp @3 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct WindowResizeEvent {
    windowId @0 :T.WindowId;
    previous @1 :T.Rect;
    current @2 :T.Rect;
    timestamp @3 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct WindowStateChangedEvent {
    windowId @0 :T.WindowId;
    previous @1 :WindowState;
    current @2 :WindowState;
    timestamp @3 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct WindowTitleChangedEvent {
    windowId @0 :T.WindowId;
    previous @1 :Text;
    current @2 :Text;
    timestamp @3 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct WindowWorkspaceChangedEvent {
    windowId @0 :T.WindowId;
    previous @1 :UInt32;
    current @2 :UInt32;
    timestamp @3 :T.Timestamp;
}

using T = import "types.capnp";

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Display — monitors, resolution, HDR, VRR, color profiles,
#           brightness, night light, dark mode
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface DisplayService {
    # State
    getInfo @0 () -> (info :DisplayInfo);

    # Brightness
    getBrightness @1 () -> (brightness :Float32);
    setBrightness @2 (brightness :Float32) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Night light
    getNightLight @3 () -> (nightLight :NightLightInfo);
    setNightLight @4 (enabled :Bool) -> T.VoidResult;
    setNightLightTemperature @5 (temperature :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;
    setNightLightSchedule @6 (start :Text, end :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Dark mode
    getDarkMode @7 () -> (enabled :Bool);
    setDarkMode @8 (enabled :Bool) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Monitors
    listMonitors @9 () -> (monitors :List(MonitorInfo));
    getMonitor @10 (output :Text) -> (monitor :MonitorInfo);
    setMonitorMode @11 (output :Text, mode :DisplayMode) -> T.VoidResult;
    setMonitorScale @12 (output :Text, scale :Float32) -> T.VoidResult;
    setMonitorPosition @13 (output :Text, x :Int32, y :Int32) -> T.VoidResult;
    setMonitorRotation @14 (output :Text, rotation :Rotation) -> T.VoidResult;
    setPrimary @15 (output :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # HDR
    getHdr @16 (output :Text) -> (hdr :HdrInfo);
    setHdr @17 (output :Text, enabled :Bool) -> T.VoidResult;

    # VRR (Variable Refresh Rate / FreeSync / G-Sync)
    getVrr @18 (output :Text) -> (vrr :VrrInfo);
    setVrr @19 (output :Text, enabled :Bool) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Color profiles
    listColorProfiles @20 (output :Text) -> (profiles :List(ColorProfile));
    getColorProfile @21 (output :Text) -> (profile :ColorProfile);
    setColorProfile @22 (output :Text, profileId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Wallpaper
    setWallpaper @23 (path :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    getWallpaper @24 () -> (path :Text);

    # Power saving
    getIdleTimeout @25 () -> (seconds :UInt32);
    setIdleTimeout @26 (seconds :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;
    getScreenBlankTimeout @27 () -> (seconds :UInt32);
    setScreenBlankTimeout @28 (seconds :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Events
    subscribe @29 () -> (subscription :DisplaySubscription);
}

struct DisplayInfo {
    brightness @0 :Float32;
    nightLight @1 :NightLightInfo;
    darkMode @2 :Bool;
    monitors @3 :List(MonitorInfo);
    primaryOutput @4 :Text;
    wallpaper @5 :Text;
    idleTimeout @6 :UInt32;
    screenBlankTimeout @7 :UInt32;
}

struct MonitorInfo {
    output @0 :Text;           # "eDP-1", "HDMI-1", etc.
    name @1 :Text;             # Human-readable name
    manufacturer @2 :Text;
    model @3 :Text;
    serial @4 :Text;
    # Current mode.
    mode @5 :DisplayMode;
    # All available modes.
    availableModes @6 :List(DisplayMode);
    scale @7 :Float32;
    position @8 :T.Point;
    rotation @9 :Rotation;
    primary @10 :Bool;
    connected @11 :Bool;
    # Physical size (mm).
    physicalWidth @12 :UInt32;
    physicalHeight @13 :UInt32;
    # HDR.
    hdr @14 :HdrInfo;
    # VRR.
    vrr @15 :VrrInfo;
    # Color profile.
    colorProfile @16 :ColorProfile;
    # Panel type (IPS, VA, TN, OLED).
    panelType @17 :Text;
    # Maximum brightness (nits).
    maxBrightness @18 :Float32;
}

struct DisplayMode {
    width @0 :UInt32;
    height @1 :UInt32;
    refreshRate @2 :Float32;   # Hz
    preferred @3 :Bool;
    current @4 :Bool;
}

enum Rotation {
    normal @0;
    left @1;         # 90° CCW
    inverted @2;     # 180°
    right @3;        # 90° CW
}

struct NightLightInfo {
    enabled @0 :Bool;
    # Color temperature (K). Lower = warmer.
    temperature @1 :UInt32;
    # Schedule (null = always on when enabled).
    scheduleStart @2 :Text;
    scheduleEnd @3 :Text;
    # Whether currently active (respects schedule).
    active @4 :Bool;
}

struct HdrInfo {
    supported @0 :Bool;
    enabled @1 :Bool;
    # HDR metadata.
    maxLuminance @2 :Float32;    # nits
    maxFrameAverage @3 :Float32; # nits
    minLuminance @4 :Float32;    # nits
    colorSpace @5 :Text;         # "bt2020", "bt709"
}

struct VrrInfo {
    supported @0 :Bool;
    enabled @1 :Bool;
    # Minimum refresh rate.
    minRefreshRate @2 :Float32;
    # Maximum refresh rate.
    maxRefreshRate @3 :Float32;
    # Technology: "freesync", "g-sync", "hdmi-vrr".
    technology @4 :Text;
}

struct ColorProfile {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    # Color space.
    colorSpace @2 :Text;       # "srgb", "dci-p3", "adobe-rgb"
    # ICC profile path.
    iccPath @3 :Text;
    # Whether this is the active profile.
    active @4 :Bool;
    # White point (K).
    whitePoint @5 :UInt32;
    # Gamma.
    gamma @6 :Float32;
}

interface DisplaySubscription {
    pull @0 () -> (events :List(DisplayEvent));
    cancel @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
}

struct DisplayEvent {
    union {
        brightnessChanged @0 :Float32;
        nightLightChanged @1 :NightLightInfo;
        darkModeChanged @2 :Bool;
        monitorConnected @3 :MonitorInfo;
        monitorDisconnected @4 :Text;
        modeChanged @5 :MonitorModeChangedEvent;
        scaleChanged @6 :MonitorScaleChangedEvent;
        hdrChanged @7 :HdrChangedEvent;
        vrrChanged @8 :VrrChangedEvent;
        custom @9 :Data;
    }
}

struct MonitorModeChangedEvent {
    output @0 :Text;
    previous @1 :DisplayMode;
    current @2 :DisplayMode;
    timestamp @3 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct MonitorScaleChangedEvent {
    output @0 :Text;
    previous @1 :Float32;
    current @2 :Float32;
    timestamp @3 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct HdrChangedEvent {
    output @0 :Text;
    enabled @1 :Bool;
    timestamp @2 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct VrrChangedEvent {
    output @0 :Text;
    enabled @1 :Bool;
    timestamp @2 :T.Timestamp;
}

using T = import "types.capnp";

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Screen Lock — screen lock state, lock/unlock, lock policy,
#               grace period, and lock screen customization
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface ScreenLockService {
    # State
    getState @0 () -> (state :ScreenLockState);

    # Lock / unlock
    lock @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
    unlock @2 (credential :Data) -> (result :UnlockResult);

    # Policy
    getPolicy @3 () -> (policy :ScreenLockPolicy);
    setPolicy @4 (policy :ScreenLockPolicy) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Grace period
    getGracePeriod @5 () -> (seconds :UInt32);
    setGracePeriod @6 (seconds :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Lock screen appearance
    getLockScreenConfig @7 () -> (config :LockScreenConfig);
    setLockScreenConfig @8 (config :LockScreenConfig) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Auto-lock
    getIdleLock @9 () -> (enabled :Bool, seconds :UInt32);
    setIdleLock @10 (enabled :Bool, seconds :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Events
    subscribe @11 () -> (subscription :ScreenLockSubscription);
}

struct ScreenLockState {
    locked @0 :Bool;
    # How the device was locked.
    lockReason @1 :LockReason;
    # When it was locked.
    lockedAt @2 :T.Timestamp;
    # Grace period remaining (if in grace).
    graceRemaining @3 :UInt32;
    # Number of failed unlock attempts.
    failedAttempts @4 :UInt32;
    # Lock screen notification count.
    notificationCount @5 :UInt32;
}

enum LockReason {
    user @0;
    idle @1;
    policy @2;
    remote @3;
    boot @4;
    suspend @5;
    failureRecovery @6;
    scheduled @7;
    custom @8;
}

enum UnlockResult {
    success @0;
    failed @1;
    lockout @2;
    cooldown @3;
    mfaRequired @4;
    custom @5;
}

struct ScreenLockPolicy {
    # Auto-lock on idle.
    idleLock @0 :Bool;
    idleTimeoutSeconds @1 :UInt32;
    # Lock on suspend.
    lockOnSuspend @2 :Bool;
    # Lock on boot.
    lockOnBoot @3 :Bool;
    # Show notifications on lock screen.
    showNotifications @4 :Bool;
    # Allow media controls on lock screen.
    mediaControls @5 :Bool;
    # Grace period after lock (seconds, 0 = no grace).
    gracePeriod @6 :UInt32;
    # Max failed attempts before lockout.
    maxFailedAttempts @7 :UInt32;
    # Lockout duration (seconds, 0 = permanent until unlock).
    lockoutDuration @8 :UInt32;
    # Require authentication to wake from blank.
    requireAuthOnWake @9 :Bool;
}

struct LockScreenConfig {
    # Wallpaper path.
    wallpaper @0 :Text;
    # Show clock.
    showClock @1 :Bool;
    # Show date.
    showDate @2 :Bool;
    # Show battery.
    showBattery @3 :Bool;
    # Show notifications (count only, no content).
    showNotificationCount @4 :Bool;
    # Custom message.
    message @5 :Text;
    # Font.
    font @6 :Text;
}

interface ScreenLockSubscription {
    pull @0 () -> (events :List(ScreenLockEvent));
    cancel @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
}

struct ScreenLockEvent {
    union {
        locked @0 :LockReason;
        unlocked @1 :UnlockResult;
        failedAttempt @2 :UInt32;
        lockout @3 :UInt32;       # Duration in seconds
        policyChanged @4 :ScreenLockPolicy;
        custom @5 :Data;
    }
}

using T = import "types.capnp";

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Text Input & IME — input methods, composition, candidates,
#                    virtual keyboard, and text input control
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface TextInputService {
    # Current input state
    getState @0 () -> (state :TextInputState);

    # IME
    listInputMethods @1 () -> (methods :List(InputMethodInfo));
    getActiveInputMethod @2 () -> (method :InputMethodInfo);
    setInputMethod @3 (methodId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    getNextInputMethod @4 () -> (method :InputMethodInfo);

    # Composition
    getComposition @5 () -> (composition :CompositionInfo);
    commitComposition @6 () -> T.VoidResult;
    cancelComposition @7 () -> T.VoidResult;

    # Candidates
    getCandidates @8 () -> (candidates :List(Candidate));
    selectCandidate @9 (index :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Virtual keyboard
    getVirtualKeyboard @10 () -> (keyboard :VirtualKeyboardInfo);
    showVirtualKeyboard @11 (layout :KeyboardLayout) -> T.VoidResult;
    hideVirtualKeyboard @12 () -> T.VoidResult;

    # Events
    subscribe @13 () -> (subscription :TextInputSubscription);
}

struct TextInputState {
    activeInputMethod @0 :Text;
    composing @1 :Bool;
    compositionText @2 :Text;
    virtualKeyboardVisible @3 :Bool;
    candidateCount @4 :UInt32;
    selectedCandidate @5 :Int32;
}

struct InputMethodInfo {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    language @2 :Text;
    # Layout type: "qwerty", "azerty", "dvorak", "cangjie", etc.
    layout @3 :Text;
    active @4 :Bool;
    # Whether this IME uses composition.
    usesComposition @5 :Bool;
    # Whether this IME provides candidates.
    hasCandidates @6 :Bool;
}

struct CompositionInfo {
    text @0 :Text;
    # Cursor position within composition.
    cursor @1 :UInt32;
    # Selection range within composition.
    selectionStart @2 :UInt32;
    selectionEnd @3 :UInt32;
}

struct Candidate {
    index @0 :UInt32;
    text @1 :Text;
    # Annotation (reading, pronunciation).
    annotation @2 :Text;
    # Frequency score.
    score @3 :Float32;
}

struct VirtualKeyboardInfo {
    visible @0 :Bool;
    layout @1 :KeyboardLayout;
    height @2 :UInt32;
    # Whether keyboard is floating.
    floating @3 :Bool;
    # Whether keyboard is split.
    split @4 :Bool;
}

enum KeyboardLayout {
    qwerty @0;
    azerty @1;
    qwertz @2;
    dvorak @3;
    colemak @4;
    numeric @5;
    phone @6;
    email @7;
    url @8;
    emoji @9;
    custom @10;
}

interface TextInputSubscription {
    pull @0 () -> (events :List(TextInputEvent));
    cancel @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
}

struct TextInputEvent {
    union {
        inputMethodChanged @0 :Text;
        compositionStarted @1 :Void;
        compositionUpdated @2 :CompositionInfo;
        compositionEnded @3 :Text;
        candidatesChanged @4 :List(Candidate);
        virtualKeyboardShown @5 :KeyboardLayout;
        virtualKeyboardHidden @6 :Void;
        custom @7 :Data;
    }
}

CLI Methods: Batch 2
bashbash# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  BATCH 2: DISPLAY & UI
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── DISPLAY ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Brief summary (bare word)
display
# Output:
#   🖥 Display
#   ├─ Brightness  ████████░░░░  65%
#   ├─ Night Light  ✗ Off (6500K)
#   ├─ Dark Mode    ◉ On
#   ├─ Primary      eDP-1  1920×1080 @ 60Hz  1.0x
#   └─ Monitors     1 connected

# Full info
display info                        → full display details

# Brightness
display brightness                  → current brightness
display brightness 80               → set brightness
display brightness +10              → increase
display brightness -10              → decrease

# Night light
display night-light                 → night light status
display night-light on              → enable
display night-light off             → disable
display night-light temp 3500       → set temperature (K)
display night-light schedule "20:00" "07:00"  → set schedule

# Dark mode
display dark-mode                   → dark mode status
display dark-mode on                → enable
display dark-mode off               → disable
display dark-mode                   → toggle

# Monitors
display monitors                    → list all monitors
display monitor eDP-1               → monitor info
display monitor eDP-1 info          → full monitor details
display monitor eDP-1 mode 1920 1080 60  → set resolution + refresh
display monitor eDP-1 mode list     → list available modes
display monitor eDP-1 scale 1.5     → set scale
display monitor eDP-1 scale +0.25   → increase scale
display monitor eDP-1 position 1920 0  → set position
display monitor eDP-1 rotate left   → rotate 90°
display monitor eDP-1 rotate normal → reset rotation
display primary eDP-1               → set primary monitor

# HDR
display monitor eDP-1 hdr           → HDR status
display monitor eDP-1 hdr on        → enable HDR
display monitor eDP-1 hdr off       → disable HDR

# VRR
display monitor eDP-1 vrr           → VRR status
display monitor eDP-1 vrr on        → enable VRR
display monitor eDP-1 vrr off       → disable VRR

# Color profiles
display monitor eDP-1 color-profiles  → list profiles
display monitor eDP-1 color-profile srgb  → set profile

# Wallpaper
display wallpaper                   → current wallpaper
display wallpaper ~/photo.jpg       → set wallpaper

# Power saving
display idle-timeout                → idle timeout
display idle-timeout 300            → set idle timeout (seconds)
display blank-timeout               → screen blank timeout
display blank-timeout 600           → set blank timeout

# Events
watch display                       → stream display events
watch display brightness            → stream brightness changes
watch display monitors              → stream monitor hotplug

# ── WINDOWS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# List (plural = list)
windows                             → list all windows
windows where focused               → focused window
windows where minimized             → minimized windows
windows where app == "firefox"      → Firefox windows
windows where workspace == 2        → windows on workspace 2
windows where title contains "doc"  → windows matching title

# Single window
window 3                            → window 3 summary
window 3 info                       → full window 3 info

# Window actions
window 3 focus                      → focus window
window 3 close                      → close window
window 3 minimize                   → minimize
window 3 maximize                   → maximize
window 3 restore                    → restore from minimize/maximize
window 3 fullscreen                 → toggle fullscreen
window 3 move 100 200               → move
window 3 resize 800 600             → resize
window 3 always-on-top              → toggle always-on-top
window 3 always-on-top on           → enable
window 3 opacity 0.8                → set opacity
window 3 decorations off            → remove decorations
window 3 decorations on             → restore decorations

# Snapping
window 3 snap left                  → snap left half
window 3 snap right                 → snap right half
window 3 snap top                   → snap top half
window 3 snap bottom                → snap bottom half
window 3 snap top-left              → snap quarter
window 3 snap top-right             → snap quarter
window 3 snap bottom-left           → snap quarter
window 3 snap bottom-right          → snap quarter
window 3 snap maximize              → snap to full
window 3 snap center                → snap to center

# Tiling
window 3 tile                       → tile window
window 3 untile                     → remove from tiling
tile 3 7 horizontal                 → tile windows 3 and 7 horizontally
tile 3 7 vertical                   → tile windows 3 and 7 vertically
tile 3 7 12 grid                    → tile 3 windows in grid

# Bulk operations
windows minimize-all                → minimize all
windows restore-all                 → restore all
windows close-app firefox           → close all Firefox windows

# Workspaces
workspaces                          → list workspaces
workspace 2                         → workspace 2 info
workspace 2 info                    → full workspace 2 info
workspace next                      → next workspace
workspace previous                  → previous workspace
workspace 2                         → switch to workspace 2
workspace create "Code"             → create workspace
workspace 5 delete                  → delete workspace
window 3 workspace 2               → move window to workspace 2
window 3 workspace next             → move window to next workspace

# Focus
focus                               → show focused window
focus next                          → focus next window
focus previous                      → focus previous window

# Focus policy
focus-policy                        → show focus policy
focus-policy click                  → click-to-focus
focus-policy follow-mouse           → focus-follows-mouse
focus-policy sloppy                 → sloppy focus

# Tiling policy
tiling-policy                       → show tiling policy
tiling-policy on                    → enable auto-tiling
tiling-policy off                   → disable auto-tiling
tiling-policy gap 10                → set gap (pixels)
tiling-policy layout fibonacci      → set default layout
tiling-policy master-ratio 0.6      → set master area ratio

# Decoration policy
decoration-policy                   → show decoration policy
decoration-policy minimal           → minimal decorations
decoration-policy none              → no decorations
decoration-policy all               → full decorations

# Events
watch windows                       → stream window events
watch windows where app == "firefox"

# ── COMPOSITOR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

compositor info                     → full compositor info
compositor layers                   → list layers
compositor layer 0 info             → layer details
compositor fps                      → current FPS
compositor vsync                    → vsync status
compositor vsync on                 → enable vsync
compositor vsync off                → disable vsync
compositor vsync adaptive           → adaptive vsync
compositor render-stats             → rendering statistics
compositor render-scale 1.5         → set render scale
compositor effects                  → list effects
compositor effect blur on           → enable effect
compositor effect blur off          → disable effect
compositor effect blur config radius 10  → configure effect
compositor screenshot               → take screenshot
compositor screenshot --region 0,0,1920,1080  → region screenshot
compositor record start             → start screen recording
compositor record start --fps 30 --codec h264  → with options
compositor record stop              → stop recording
compositor gpu                      → GPU rendering info

# Events
watch compositor                    → stream compositor events
watch compositor fps                → stream FPS changes

# ── THEME ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Brief summary (bare word)
theme
# Output:
#   🎨 Theme
#   ├─ Mode      Dark
#   ├─ Accent    ████  #3b82f6
#   ├─ Font      Inter 14px
#   ├─ Mono      JetBrains Mono 13px
#   ├─ Radius    8px
#   └─ Motion    Normal

# Full info
theme info                          → full theme details
theme dark-mode                     → toggle dark mode
theme dark-mode on                  → enable
theme dark-mode off                 → disable
theme accent "#3b82f6"              → set accent color
theme font "Inter"                  → set UI font
theme font-mono "JetBrains Mono"    → set monospace font
theme font-size 14                  → set font size
theme radius 8                      → set corner radius
theme motion normal                 → set motion level
theme motion reduced                → reduced motion
theme motion none                   → no animations

# Events
watch theme                         → stream theme changes

# ── FONTS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# List (plural = list)
fonts                               → list font families
fonts where monospace               → monospace fonts
fonts where sans-serif              → sans-serif fonts
font "Liberation Sans"              → font info
font "Liberation Sans" info         → full font details
font find sans 700                  → find bold sans font
font system                         → system font
font monospace                      → system monospace font
font metrics "Liberation Sans" 14   → get metrics at size
font install ~/MyFont.ttf           → install font
font remove "Old Font"              → remove font

# ── CLIPBOARD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Brief summary (bare word)
clipboard
# Output:
#   📋 Clipboard
#   ├─ Type    Text
#   ├─ Content "Hello, world!"
#   ├─ Source   Terminal
#   └─ Time     2 min ago

# Full info
clipboard info                      → full clipboard details
clipboard get                       → get content
clipboard set "Hello"               → set text
clipboard set --file ~/photo.png    → set file content
clipboard history                   → show history
clipboard history 20                → last 20 entries
clipboard clear                     → clear
clipboard pin 3                     → pin entry
clipboard unpin 3                   → unpin entry

# Events
watch clipboard                     → stream clipboard changes

# ── SCREENLOCK ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Brief summary (bare word)
access
# Output:
#   🔒 Access
#   ├─ State     Unlocked
#   ├─ Method    Password + Biometric
#   ├─ Session   Active (3h 42m)
#   └─ Lockout   None (0 failed attempts)

# Full info (under access domain)
access lock                         → lock screen immediately
access unlock                       → unlock (prompts for credential)
access lockout-policy               → show lockout policy
access lockout-policy set max-attempts 5  → set max attempts
access lockout-policy set lockout-duration 300  → set lockout (seconds)
access idle-lock                    → idle lock status
access idle-lock on 300             → lock after 5 min idle
access idle-lock off                → disable idle lock
access grace-period                 → grace period
access grace-period 10              → set grace period (seconds)
access lock-screen                  → lock screen config
access lock-screen wallpaper ~/lock.jpg  → set lock screen wallpaper
access lock-screen clock on         → show clock
access lock-screen notifications on → show notification count
access lock-screen message "Welcome back!"  → set message
access policy                       → full lock policy
access policy lock-on-suspend on    → lock on suspend
access policy lock-on-boot on       → lock on boot
access policy show-notifications on → show notifications on lock
access policy media-controls on     → media controls on lock
access policy require-auth-on-wake on  → require auth to wake

# Events
watch access                        → stream access events

# ── TEXT INPUT / IME ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

textinput info                      → full text input state
textinput methods                   → list input methods
textinput method                    → active input method
textinput method "fcitx5"           → set input method
textinput method next               → switch to next
textinput composition               → current composition
textinput candidates                → current candidates
textinput candidate 3               → select candidate #3
textinput keyboard                  → virtual keyboard status
textinput keyboard show             → show virtual keyboard
textinput keyboard show --layout qwerty  → show with layout
textinput keyboard hide             → hide virtual keyboard
textinput keyboard layout           → current layout
textinput keyboard layout dvorak    → set layout

# Events
watch textinput                     → stream text input events

# ── ACCESSIBILITY ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

accessibility info                  → full accessibility state
accessibility tree                  → accessibility tree
accessibility tree --depth 3        → limited depth
accessibility node <id> info        → node details
accessibility node <id> inspect     → full inspection
accessibility node <id> perform press  → perform action
accessibility node <id> aria        → ARIA properties
accessibility node <id> aria set label "Submit"  → set ARIA label
accessibility focus                 → currently focused node
accessibility focus set <id>        → set focus
accessibility preferences           → accessibility preferences
accessibility preferences text-scale 1.5  → set text scale
accessibility preferences high-contrast on  → enable high contrast
accessibility preferences screen-reader on  → enable screen reader
accessibility preferences reduced-motion on  → enable reduced motion
accessibility preferences magnifier on  → enable magnifier
accessibility preferences magnifier-scale 2.0  → set magnifier scale
accessibility preferences switch-control on  → enable switch control
accessibility preferences voice-control on  → enable voice control
accessibility preferences sticky-keys on  → enable sticky keys
accessibility preferences slow-keys on  → enable slow keys
accessibility preferences bounce-keys on  → enable bounce keys
accessibility preferences captions on  → enable captions
accessibility flat-tree             → flat list for linear nav
accessibility export-json           → export tree as JSON
accessibility text-attributes <id>  → text formatting info

# Events
watch accessibility                 → stream accessibility events

Edge Cases: Batch 2
texttextDISPLAY
├─ Set brightness to 0%
│  → "Brightness cannot be 0%. Minimum: 5%."
│  → "Try: display brightness 5"
├─ Monitor hotplug during watch stream
│  → Stream updates immediately. "Monitor HDMI-1 connected (3840×2160 @ 60Hz)"
├─ Set resolution not supported by monitor
│  → "Resolution 3840×2160 @ 144Hz not supported by eDP-1."
│  → "Available: 1920×1080@60, 1920×1080@120, 1600×900@60"
├─ HDR on non-HDR monitor
│  → "HDR not supported by eDP-1. HDR requires compatible display hardware."
├─ VRR on non-VRR monitor
│  → "VRR not supported by eDP-1. Requires FreeSync or G-Sync compatible display."
├─ Scale set to extreme value
│  → "Scale 5.0x may make the interface unusable. Maximum recommended: 3.0x."
│  → "Continue anyway? [y/N]"
├─ Night light temperature too low
│  → "Temperature 500K is extremely warm. Minimum: 1000K."
│  → "Try: display night-light temp 2000"
├─ Color profile not found
│  → "Profile 'adobe-rgb' not found for eDP-1."
│  → "Available: srgb, dci-p3. Run: display monitor eDP-1 color-profiles"
├─ Monitor position overlaps
│  → Warning: "Monitor HDMI-1 overlaps with eDP-1 at position (0,0)."
│  → "Windows may be hidden behind the overlap area."
├─ Wallpaper file not found
│  → "File '~/photo.jpg' not found."
│  → "Try: display wallpaper ~/Pictures/"

WINDOWS
├─ Window not found (closed between list and action)
│  → "Window 3 no longer exists. It may have been closed."
│  → "Run: windows to see current windows."
├─ Snap on disconnected monitor
│  → "Cannot snap: Window is on monitor HDMI-1 which was disconnected."
│  → "Run: display monitors to see connected monitors."
├─ Move window to non-existent workspace
│  → "Workspace 99 does not exist."
│  → "Run: workspaces to see available workspaces."
│  → "Run: workspace create to create a new workspace."
├─ Tile with single window
│  → "Tiling with one window has no effect. Add more windows."
├─ Close last window on workspace
│  → Allowed. Workspace remains. Shows "(empty)" in workspaces list.
├─ Focus policy conflict
│  → "Cannot enable both 'click-to-focus' and 'focus-follows-mouse'."
│  → "Choose one: focus-policy click OR focus-policy follow-mouse"
├─ Always-on-top with fullscreen
│  → "Fullscreen mode overrides always-on-top. Window will exit fullscreen first."
├─ Minimize all with lock screen active
│  → "Cannot minimize windows while screen is locked."
├─ Workspace with 1000 windows
│  → Paginated. "Showing 1-50 of 1000. Use --page 2 for more."

COMPOSITOR
├─ Screenshot with no display
│  → "No display available for screenshot."
├─ Recording disk full
│  → "Screen recording stopped: disk space exhausted."
│  → "Recording saved (partial): /tmp/recording-2025-01-15.mp4"
├─ FPS drop below threshold
│  → Auto-alert: "Compositor FPS dropped to 30 (target: 60)."
│  → "Run: compositor render-stats for details."
├─ Effect not supported by renderer
│  → "Effect 'blur' not supported by software renderer."
│  → "GPU acceleration required. Run: compositor info"
├─ Layer created by crashed app
│  → Layer destroyed automatically. Event emitted.

ACCESSIBILITY
├─ Screen reader on text-heavy page
│  → Tree traversal works. Text attributes (bold, links) reported.
├─ Node destroyed during inspection
│  → "Node 42 no longer exists. The UI may have changed."
│  → "Run: accessibility tree to see current tree."
├─ ARIA labelledby references non-existent node
│  → "aria-labelledby references node 99 which does not exist."
│  → "Label resolution partial. Source nodes: [42]"
├─ Magnifier with multiple monitors
│  → Magnifier applies to primary monitor. "Magnifier active on eDP-1."

SCREENLOCK
├─ Lock during active file transfer
│  → Lock succeeds. File transfer continues in background.
│  → Unlock shows: "File transfer in progress (342 MB / 1 GB)"
├─ Lockout after too many attempts
│  → "Locked out for 300 seconds after 5 failed attempts."
│  → Countdown shown on lock screen.
├─ Grace period expired mid-operation
│  → "Grace period expired. Device locked."
├─ Idle lock while watching video
│  → "Idle lock suppressed: media playback detected."
│  → (Compositor reports active video frames.)
└─ Lock screen with dead battery
   → "Battery critical (2%). Auto-shutdown in 60 seconds."
   → Lock screen shows countdown.
