using T = import "types.capnp";

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Auth — authentication, tokens, SSO, session management
#
# Not the credential unlock flow (that's access.capnp). This is
# the broader authentication surface: user authentication, bearer
# tokens, SSO, OAuth, session tokens, and auth providers.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface AuthService {
    # Current auth state
    getState @0 () -> (state :AuthState);

    # Login / logout
    login @1 (request :LoginRequest) -> (result :LoginResult);
    logout @2 () -> T.VoidResult;

    # Tokens
    listTokens @3 (pagination :T.Pagination) -> (tokens :List(TokenInfo), total :UInt32);
    createToken @4 (request :TokenRequest) -> (token :TokenInfo);
    revokeToken @5 (tokenId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    revokeAllTokens @6 () -> T.VoidResult;
    refreshToken @7 (tokenId :Text) -> (token :TokenInfo);

    # SSO
    listProviders @8 () -> (providers :List(AuthProvider));
    initiateSso @9 (providerId :Text) -> (redirectUrl :Text);
    completeSso @10 (providerId :Text, callbackData :Data) -> (result :LoginResult);

    # Sessions
    listSessions @11 (pagination :T.Pagination) -> (sessions :List(AuthSession), total :UInt32);
    revokeSession @12 (sessionId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Two-factor
    listFactors @13 () -> (factors :List(AuthFactor));
    enrollFactor @14 (factor :AuthFactor) -> (enrollment :FactorEnrollment);
    verifyFactor @15 (factorId :Text, code :Text) -> (result :VerifyResult);
    removeFactor @16 (factorId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Events
    subscribe @17 () -> (subscription :AuthSubscription);
}

struct AuthState {
    authenticated @0 :Bool;
    userId @1 :Text;
    username @2 :Text;
    # How the user authenticated.
    method @3 :AuthMethod;
    # When the session started.
    sessionStarted @4 :T.Timestamp;
    # When the session expires.
    sessionExpires @5 :T.Timestamp;
    # Active factors.
    factorsUsed @6 :List(Text);
    # Token count.
    tokenCount @7 :UInt32;
}

enum AuthMethod {
    password @0;
    token @1;
    sso @2;
    biometric @3;
    certificate @4;
    hardware @5;
    custom @6;
}

struct LoginRequest {
    username @0 :Text;
    password @1 :Text;
    # For token-based auth.
    token @2 :Text;
    # For SSO.
    providerId @3 :Text;
    # Whether to persist the session.
    persistent @4 :Bool;
    # Session duration requested.
    duration @5 :T.Duration;
}

struct LoginResult {
    union {
        success @0 :LoginSuccess;
        failed @1 :T.Error;
        mfaRequired @2 :MfaChallenge;
        ssoRedirect @3 :Text;
        custom @4 :Data;
    }
}

struct LoginSuccess {
    userId @0 :Text;
    username @1 :Text;
    sessionToken @2 :Text;
    expiresAt @3 :T.Timestamp;
    method @4 :AuthMethod;
}

struct MfaChallenge {
    challengeId @0 :Text;
    method @1 :Text;
    issuedAt @2 :T.Timestamp;
    expiresAt @3 :T.Timestamp;
}

# ── Tokens ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct TokenInfo {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    # Token type.
    type @2 :TokenType;
    # When created.
    createdAt @3 :T.Timestamp;
    # When it expires.
    expiresAt @4 :T.Timestamp;
    # When it was last used.
    lastUsedAt @5 :T.Timestamp;
    # Scopes granted.
    scopes @6 :List(Text);
    # Whether this token is active.
    active @7 :Bool;
}

enum TokenType {
    bearer @0;
    api @1;
    session @2;
    refresh @3;
    oauth @4;
    custom @5;
}

struct TokenRequest {
    name @0 :Text;
    type @1 :TokenType;
    scopes @2 :List(Text);
    duration @3 :T.Duration;
    # Whether the token is renewable.
    renewable @4 :Bool;
}

# ── SSO Providers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct AuthProvider {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    type @2 :ProviderType;
    # Whether this provider is enabled.
    enabled @3 :Bool;
    # Whether the user has authenticated with this provider.
    connected @4 :Bool;
}

enum ProviderType {
    oauth2 @0;
    oidc @1;
    saml @2;
    ldap @3;
    custom @4;
}

# ── Sessions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct AuthSession {
    id @0 :Text;
    userId @1 :Text;
    # Device info.
    device @2 :Text;
    # IP address.
    ip @3 :Text;
    # Location (if available).
    location @4 :Text;
    # When started.
    startedAt @5 :T.Timestamp;
    # Last activity.
    lastActivity @6 :T.Timestamp;
    # When it expires.
    expiresAt @7 :T.Timestamp;
    # Whether this is the current session.
    current @8 :Bool;
    # Auth method used.
    method @9 :AuthMethod;
}

# ── Auth Factors ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct AuthFactor {
    id @0 :Text;
    type @1 :FactorType;
    name @2 :Text;
    enrolled @3 :Bool;
    enrolledAt @4 :T.Timestamp;
    lastUsedAt @5 :T.Timestamp;
}

enum FactorType {
    totp @0;
    webauthn @1;
    sms @2;
    email @3;
    backup @4;
    hardware @5;
    custom @6;
}

struct FactorEnrollment {
    factorId @0 :Text;
    # Setup data (e.g., TOTP URI, QR code data).
    setupData @1 :Data;
    # Backup codes (if applicable).
    backupCodes @2 :List(Text);
}

struct VerifyResult {
    success @0 :Bool;
    error @1 :Text;
    # Remaining attempts before lockout.
    remainingAttempts @2 :UInt32;
}

# ── Auth Events ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface AuthSubscription {
    pull @0 () -> (events :List(AuthEvent));
    cancel @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
}

struct AuthEvent {
    union {
        loggedIn @0 :LoginSuccess;
        loggedOut @1 :Void;
        tokenCreated @2 :TokenInfo;
        tokenRevoked @3 :Text;
        sessionCreated @4 :AuthSession;
        sessionRevoked @5 :Text;
        factorEnrolled @6 :AuthFactor;
        factorRemoved @7 :Text;
        suspiciousActivity @8 :SuspiciousActivityEvent;
        custom @9 :Data;
    }
}

struct SuspiciousActivityEvent {
    description @0 :Text;
    ip @1 :Text;
    device @2 :Text;
    timestamp @3 :T.Timestamp;
    # Recommended action.
    recommendedAction @4 :Text;
}

using T = import "types.capnp";

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Crypto — encryption, decryption, signing, verification, hashing,
#          key exchange, and random generation
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface CryptoService {
    # Symmetric encryption
    encrypt @0 (request :EncryptRequest) -> (result :EncryptResult);
    decrypt @1 (request :DecryptRequest) -> (result :DecryptResult);

    # Signing
    sign @2 (request :SignRequest) -> (result :SignResult);
    verify @3 (request :VerifyRequest) -> (result :VerifyResult);

    # Hashing
    hash @4 (request :HashRequest) -> (result :HashResult);

    # Key exchange
    keyExchange @5 (request :KeyExchangeRequest) -> (result :KeyExchangeResult);

    # Random
    generateRandom @6 (length :UInt32) -> (data :Data);
    generatePassword @7 (length :UInt32, charset :PasswordCharset) -> (password :Text);

    # Certificate operations
    listCertificates @8 () -> (certificates :List(CertificateInfo));
    getCertificate @9 (id :Text) -> (cert :CertificateInfo);
    verifyCertificate @10 (id :Text) -> (result :CertificateVerifyResult);
    importCertificate @11 (data :Data, format :CertificateFormat) -> (id :Text);
    exportCertificate @12 (id :Text, format :CertificateFormat) -> (data :Data);

    # Supported algorithms
    listAlgorithms @13 () -> (algorithms :List(AlgorithmInfo));
}

struct EncryptRequest {
    data @0 :Data;
    algorithm @1 :Text;        # "aes-256-gcm", "chacha20-poly1305"
    key @2 :Data;              # Key or key ID
    # Additional authenticated data.
    aad @3 :Data;
}

struct EncryptResult {
    ciphertext @0 :Data;
    iv @1 :Data;
    tag @2 :Data;
    algorithm @3 :Text;
}

struct DecryptRequest {
    ciphertext @0 :Data;
    algorithm @1 :Text;
    key @2 :Data;
    iv @3 :Data;
    tag @4 :Data;
    aad @5 :Data;
}

struct DecryptResult {
    plaintext @0 :Data;
    verified @1 :Bool;
}

struct SignRequest {
    data @0 :Data;
    algorithm @1 :Text;        # "ed25519", "ecdsa-p256", "rsa-pss"
    keyId @2 :Text;            # Key ID from key_management
}

struct SignResult {
    signature @0 :Data;
    algorithm @1 :Text;
    keyId @2 :Text;
}

struct VerifyRequest {
    data @0 :Data;
    signature @1 :Data;
    algorithm @2 :Text;
    keyId @3 :Text;
    publicKey @4 :Data;        # Or provide public key directly
}

struct VerifyResult {
    valid @0 :Bool;
    algorithm @1 :Text;
    keyId @2 :Text;
    error @3 :Text;
}

struct HashRequest {
    data @0 :Data;
    algorithm @1 :Text;        # "sha256", "sha512", "blake3"
}

struct HashResult {
    hash @0 :Data;
    algorithm @1 :Text;
    hex @2 :Text;              # Hex-encoded hash
}

struct KeyExchangeRequest {
    algorithm @1 :Text;        # "x25519", "ecdh-p256"
    ourPublicKey @2 :Data;
    theirPublicKey @3 :Data;
}

struct KeyExchangeResult {
    sharedSecret @0 :Data;
    algorithm @1 :Text;
}

enum PasswordCharset {
    alphanumeric @0;
    alpha @1;
    numeric @2;
    symbols @3;
    all @4;
    custom @5;
}

struct CertificateInfo {
    id @0 :Text;
    subject @1 :Text;
    issuer @2 :Text;
    serial @3 :Text;
    notBefore @4 :T.Timestamp;
    notAfter @5 :T.Timestamp;
    fingerprint @6 :Text;
    algorithm @7 :Text;
    keySize @8 :UInt32;
    # Whether this certificate is currently valid.
    valid @9 :Bool;
    # SANs (Subject Alternative Names).
    sans @10 :List(Text);
}

enum CertificateFormat {
    pem @0;
    der @1;
    pkcs12 @2;
    custom @3;
}

struct CertificateVerifyResult {
    valid @0 :Bool;
    chain @1 :List(CertificateInfo);
    error @2 :Text;
    # Whether the certificate is expired.
    expired @3 :Bool;
    # Whether the certificate is revoked.
    revoked @4 :Bool;
}

struct AlgorithmInfo {
    name @0 :Text;
    type @1 :Text;             # "symmetric", "asymmetric", "hash", "kex"
    keySize @2 :UInt32;
    description @3 :Text;
    # Whether this algorithm is considered secure.
    secure @4 :Bool;
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Key Management — key storage, rotation, derivation, export,
#                  and hardware security module integration
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface KeyManagementService {
    # Keys
    listKeys @0 (filter :KeyFilter) -> (keys :List(KeyInfo), total :UInt32);
    getKey @1 (keyId :Text) -> (key :KeyInfo);
    generateKey @2 (request :GenerateKeyRequest) -> (key :KeyInfo);
    importKey @3 (request :ImportKeyRequest) -> (key :KeyInfo);
    exportKey @4 (keyId :Text, format :KeyFormat) -> (data :Data);
    deleteKey @5 (keyId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Rotation
    rotateKey @6 (keyId :Text) -> (newKey :KeyInfo);
    getRotationPolicy @7 (keyId :Text) -> (policy :RotationPolicy);
    setRotationPolicy @8 (keyId :Text, policy :RotationPolicy) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Derivation
    deriveKey @9 (request :DeriveKeyRequest) -> (key :KeyInfo);

    # HSM
    listHsmDevices @10 () -> (devices :List(HsmDeviceInfo));
    getHsmDevice @11 (deviceId :Text) -> (device :HsmDeviceInfo);
    generateHsmKey @12 (deviceId :Text, request :GenerateKeyRequest) -> (key :KeyInfo);

    # Events
    subscribe @13 () -> (subscription :KeySubscription);
}

struct KeyInfo {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    type @2 :KeyType;
    algorithm @3 :Text;
    keySize @4 :UInt32;
    createdAt @5 :T.Timestamp;
    expiresAt @6 :T.Timestamp;
    lastUsedAt @7 :T.Timestamp;
    useCount @8 :UInt64;
    # Whether the key can be exported.
    exportable @9 :Bool;
    # Whether the key is stored in hardware.
    hardware @10 :Bool;
    # Key purpose.
    purpose @11 :List(KeyPurpose);
    # Rotation policy.
    rotationPolicy @12 :RotationPolicy;
    # Tags.
    tags @13 :List(Text);
}

enum KeyType {
    symmetric @0;
    asymmetric @1;
    hmac @2;
    custom @3;
}

enum KeyPurpose {
    encrypt @0;
    decrypt @1;
    sign @2;
    verify @3;
    keyExchange @4;
    derive @5;
    custom @6;
}

struct KeyFilter {
    type @0 :KeyType;
    purpose @1 :KeyPurpose;
    hardware @2 :T.BoolFilter;
    expiringSoon @3 :Bool;      # Within 30 days
    tags @4 :List(Text);
}

struct GenerateKeyRequest {
    name @0 :Text;
    type @1 :KeyType;
    algorithm @2 :Text;
    keySize @3 :UInt32;
    purpose @4 :List(KeyPurpose);

}

struct ImportKeyRequest {
    name @0 :Text;

    format @2 :KeyFormat;
    purpose @3 :List(KeyPurpose);

}

enum KeyFormat {
    raw @0;
    pem @1;
    pkcs8 @2;
    jwk @3;
    custom @4;
}

struct RotationPolicy {

    interval @0 :T.Duration;
    # Whether to keep old versions.
    keepOldVersions @1 :Bool;
    # Number of old versions to keep.
    maxOldVersions @2 :UInt32;
    # Whether auto-rotation is enabled.
    autoRotate @3 :Bool;
}

struct DeriveKeyRequest {
    sourceKeyId @0 :Text;
    algorithm @1 :Text;         # "hkdf", "pbkdf2"
    salt @2 :Data;
    info @3 :Data;
    keySize @4 :UInt32;
    name @5 :Text;
}

struct HsmDeviceInfo {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    type @2 :Text;              # "tpm", "smartcard", "yubikey"
    manufacturer @3 :Text;
    serial @4 :Text;
    # Whether the device is connected.
    connected @5 :Bool;
    # Number of keys stored.
    keyCount @6 :UInt32;
    # Available storage slots.
    freeSlots @7 :UInt32;
    # FIPS level (if applicable).
    fipsLevel @8 :Text;
}

interface KeySubscription {
    pull @0 () -> (events :List(KeyEvent));
    cancel @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
}

struct KeyEvent {

        keyImported @1 :KeyInfo;
        keyRotated @2 :KeyRotatedEvent;
        keyDeleted @3 :Text;
        keyExpired @4 :Text;
        hsmConnected @5 :HsmDeviceInfo;
        hsmDisconnected @6 :Text;
        custom @7 :Data;
    }
}

struct KeyRotatedEvent {

    timestamp @3 :T.Timestamp;

using T = import "types.capnp";

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Signature — binary signing, verification, trust chains,
#             and code signing policies
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface SignatureService {
    # Sign / verify binaries
    sign @0 (request :SignBinaryRequest) -> (result :SignBinaryResult);
    verify @1 (request :VerifyBinaryRequest) -> (result :VerifyBinaryResult);

    # Trust store
    listTrustedKeys @2 () -> (keys :List(TrustedKey));
    addTrustedKey @3 (key :TrustedKey) -> T.VoidResult;
    removeTrustedKey @4 (keyId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Trust chain
    verifyChain @5 (chain :List(Data)) -> (result :ChainVerifyResult);
    getChain @6 (keyId :Text) -> (chain :List(TrustedKey));

    # Signing policies
    getPolicy @7 () -> (policy :SigningPolicy);
    setPolicy @8 (policy :SigningPolicy) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Audit
    getAuditLog @9 (pagination :T.Pagination) -> (entries :List(SignatureAuditEntry), total :UInt32);
}

struct SignBinaryRequest {
    path @0 :Text;
    keyId @1 :Text;
    algorithm @2 :Text;
    # Timestamp the signature.
    timestamp @3 :Bool;
    # Detached signature (separate file) or embedded.
    detached @4 :Bool;
}

struct SignBinaryResult {
    signaturePath @0 :Text;
    fingerprint @1 :Text;
    timestamp @2 :T.Timestamp;
    algorithm @3 :Text;
}

struct VerifyBinaryRequest {
    path @0 :Text;
    # Signature path (for detached signatures).
    signaturePath @1 :Text;
}

struct VerifyBinaryResult {
    valid @0 :Bool;
    signedBy @1 :Text;
    signedAt @2 :T.Timestamp;
    keyId @3 :Text;
    fingerprint @4 :Text;
    algorithm @5 :Text;
    # Whether the signer is trusted.
    trusted @6 :Bool;
    # Trust chain.
    chain @7 :List(TrustedKey);
    error @8 :Text;
}

struct TrustedKey {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    fingerprint @2 :Text;
    publicKey @3 :Data;
    algorithm @4 :Text;
    addedAt @5 :T.Timestamp;
    expiresAt @6 :T.Timestamp;
    # Trust level.
    trustLevel @7 :TrustLevel;
    # Source of trust (user-added, system, vendor).
    source @8 :Text;
}

enum TrustLevel {
    unknown @0;
    low @1;
    medium @2;
    high @3;
    ultimate @4;
}

struct ChainVerifyResult {
    valid @0 :Bool;
    chain @1 :List(TrustedKey);
    # Where the chain breaks (if invalid).
    breakPoint @2 :Text;
    error @3 :Text;
}

struct SigningPolicy {
    # Require all binaries to be signed.
    requireSignature @0 :Bool;
    # Minimum trust level required.
    minTrustLevel @1 :TrustLevel;
    # Whether to check certificate revocation.
    checkRevocation @2 :Bool;
    # Whether to require timestamps.
    requireTimestamp @3 :Bool;
    # Allowed algorithms.
    allowedAlgorithms @4 :List(Text);
    # Block unsigned binaries.
    blockUnsigned @5 :Bool;
}

struct SignatureAuditEntry {
    id @0 :UInt64;
    action @1 :Text;            # "sign", "verify", "key-add", "key-remove"
    path @2 :Text;
    keyId @3 :Text;
    result @4 :Bool;
    timestamp @5 :T.Timestamp;
    user @6 :Text;
}

CLI Methods: Batch 3
bashbash# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  BATCH 3: SECURITY & ACCESS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── ACCESS (device lock, credentials, MFA, recovery) ──────────────────

# Brief summary (bare word)
access
# Output:
#   🔒 Access
#   ├─ State     Unlocked
#   ├─ Method    Password + Biometric
#   ├─ Session   Active (3h 42m, device scope)
#   └─ Lockout   None (0 failed attempts)

# Full info
access info                         → full access details

# Lock / unlock
access lock                         → lock device
access lock --reason user           → lock with reason
access lock --reason idle           → lock with reason
access lock --reason policy         → lock with reason
access unlock                       → unlock (prompts for credential)

# State
access locked                       → is locked? (true/false)
access lock-reason                  → why is it locked?
access session                      → active session
access sessions                     → list active sessions
access session revoke 42            → revoke session

# Lock method
access lock-method                  → current lock method
access lock-method password         → set to password
access lock-method pin              → set to PIN
access lock-method biometric        → set to biometric
access lock-method combined         → set to multi-factor

# Lockout policy
access lockout-policy               → show lockout policy
access lockout-policy set max-attempts 5        → max failed attempts
access lockout-policy set lockout-duration 300   → lockout duration (sec)
access lockout-policy set cooldown 5             → cooldown per attempt
access lockout-policy set wipe-after 10          → wipe after N fails
access lockout-policy set require-mfa-after 3    → require MFA after N

# Credentials
access credentials                  → list credentials
access credential enroll            → enroll new credential
access credential revoke <id>       → revoke credential
access credential assess <id>       → assess credential strength

# MFA
access mfa                          → MFA status
access mfa enroll totp              → enroll TOTP
access mfa enroll hardware-key      → enroll hardware key
access mfa enroll sms               → enroll SMS
access mfa revoke <id>              → revoke MFA factor
access mfa challenge                → request MFA challenge
access mfa verify <id> <code>       → verify MFA code

# Recovery
access recovery                     → recovery status
access recovery start               → start recovery flow
access recovery codes               → list recovery codes
access recovery codes generate 10   → generate 10 recovery codes
access recovery submit <code>       → submit recovery code
access recovery methods             → list recovery methods

# Backup credentials
access backups                      → list backup credentials
access backup enroll                → enroll backup credential
access backup revoke <id>           → revoke backup
access backup rotate <id>           → rotate backup credential

# Policy
access policy                       → full lock policy
access policy lock-on-suspend on    → lock on suspend
access policy lock-on-boot on       → lock on boot
access policy show-notifications on → show on lock screen
access policy media-controls on     → media controls on lock
access policy require-auth-on-wake on  → require auth to wake
access policy grace-period 10       → grace period (seconds)
access policy idle-lock on 300      → auto-lock after 5 min

# Lock screen customization
access lock-screen                  → lock screen config
access lock-screen wallpaper ~/lock.jpg  → wallpaper
access lock-screen clock on         → show clock
access lock-screen date on          → show date
access lock-screen battery on       → show battery
access lock-screen message "Welcome back!"  → custom message

# Backend
access backends                     → list backends
access backend set tpm              → set active backend

# Events
watch access                        → stream access events

# ── AUTH (authentication, tokens, SSO) ────────────────────────────────

auth info                           → full auth state
auth login                          → login (interactive prompt)
auth login --user lufuno            → login with user
auth logout                         → logout

# Tokens
auth tokens                         → list tokens
auth token create "my-app"          → create bearer token
auth token create "api" --type api --scopes "read,write"  → API token
auth token revoke <id>              → revoke token
auth token revoke-all               → revoke all tokens
auth token refresh <id>             → refresh expiring token

# SSO
auth providers                      → list SSO providers
auth sso <provider-id>              → initiate SSO flow

# Sessions
auth sessions                       → list all sessions
auth session revoke <id>            → revoke session

# Two-factor
auth factors                        → list auth factors
auth factor enroll totp             → enroll TOTP
auth factor enroll webauthn         → enroll WebAuthn
auth factor verify <id> <code>      → verify factor
auth factor remove <id>             → remove factor

# Events
watch auth                          → stream auth events

# ── SECRETS (keyring) ────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Brief summary (bare word)
secrets
# Output:
#   🔑 Secrets
#   ├─ Total    12 stored
#   ├─ Recent   wifi-password (2h ago)
#   └─ Backend  system-keyring

# Full info
secrets info                        → full keyring details
secrets                             → list all secrets
secret get "wifi-password"          → get secret
secret set "api-key" "sk-abc123"    → set secret
secret delete "old-key"             → delete secret

# ── CRYPTO (encryption, signing, hashing) ─────────────────────────────

crypto info                         → supported algorithms

# Hashing
crypto hash "hello" --algorithm sha256       → hash string
crypto hash --file ~/doc.txt --algorithm blake3  → hash file
crypto hash --file ~/doc.txt                 → hash with default (sha256)

# Encryption
crypto encrypt --file ~/secret.txt --key <key-id>  → encrypt file
crypto decrypt --file ~/secret.txt.enc --key <key-id>  → decrypt file
crypto encrypt "secret message" --key <key-id> → encrypt string

# Signing
crypto sign --file ~/app.bin --key <key-id>       → sign file
crypto verify --file ~/app.bin --signature ~/app.bin.sig  → verify

# Password generation
crypto password                            → generate password
crypto password --length 32                → 32-char password
crypto password --charset alphanumeric     → alphanumeric only
crypto password --charset symbols          → include symbols

# Random
crypto random 32                           → 32 bytes random data

# Certificates
crypto certificates                        → list certificates
crypto certificate <id> info               → certificate details
crypto certificate verify <id>             → verify certificate
crypto certificate import ~/cert.pem       → import certificate
crypto certificate export <id> ~/export.pem → export certificate

# ── KEYS (key management) ─────────────────────────────────────────────

keys                                  → list all keys
keys where type == asymmetric         → asymmetric keys only
keys where expiring-soon              → expiring within 30 days
keys where hardware                   → hardware-stored keys
key <id> info                         → key details

# Key generation
key generate --name "my-key" --algorithm ed25519     → generate key
key generate --name "aes-key" --type symmetric --algorithm aes-256  → symmetric key
key generate --name "hsm-key" --hardware true        → generate in HSM

# Key operations
key import ~/my-key.pem --format pem     → import key
key export <id> ~/export.pem --format pem → export key
key delete <id>                          → delete key

# Rotation
key <id> rotate                          → rotate key
key <id> rotation-policy                 → show rotation policy
key <id> rotation-policy set interval 30d  → auto-rotate every 30 days
key <id> rotation-policy set auto on     → enable auto-rotation

# Derivation
key derive <source-id> --algorithm hkdf --salt "salt" --info "info"  → derive key

# HSM
keys hsm                                 → list HSM devices
key hsm <device-id> info                 → HSM device details

# Events
watch keys                               → stream key events

# ── SIGNATURE (binary signing, trust) ────────────────────────────────

signature info                         → signing policy
signature sign ~/app.bin --key <key-id>       → sign binary
signature verify ~/app.bin                     → verify binary
signature verify ~/app.bin --signature ~/app.bin.sig  → verify detached

# Trust store
signature trust                          → list trusted keys
signature trust add ~/vendor-key.pem     → add trusted key
signature trust remove <id>              → remove trusted key

# Trust chain
signature chain ~/app.bin                → show trust chain
signature chain verify <key-id>          → verify trust chain

# Policy
signature policy                         → show signing policy
signature policy require on              → require all binaries signed
signature policy min-trust high          → minimum trust level
signature policy check-revocation on     → check cert revocation
signature policy require-timestamp on    → require timestamps
signature policy block-unsigned on       → block unsigned binaries

# Audit
signature audit                          → signing audit log
signature audit --since 24h              → last 24h entries

# ── CRYPTO CERTIFICATES (TLS/SSL) ────────────────────────────────────

crypto certificates                      → list certificates
crypto certificate <id> info             → certificate details
crypto certificate verify <id>           → verify certificate
crypto certificate import ~/cert.pem     → import
crypto certificate export <id> ~/out.pem → export

Batch 4: Networking

Schemas
network.capnp
capnpcapnp@0xa1b2c3d4e5f60060;

using T = import "types.capnp";

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Network — WiFi, Ethernet, interfaces, routes, firewall,
#           bandwidth, and connection management
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface NetworkService {
    # State
    getInfo @0 () -> (info :NetworkInfo);

    # Interfaces
    listInterfaces @1 () -> (interfaces :List(InterfaceInfo));
    getInterface @2 (name :Text) -> (iface :InterfaceInfo);
    enableInterface @3 (name :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    disableInterface @4 (name :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # WiFi
    getWifi @5 () -> (wifi :WifiInfo);
    setWifi @6 (enabled :Bool) -> T.VoidResult;
    scanWifi @7 () -> (networks :List(WifiNetwork>);
    connectWifi @8 (ssid :Text, password :Text) -> (result :ConnectResult);
    disconnectWifi @9 () -> T.VoidResult;
    forgetWifi @10 (ssid :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    listSavedWifi @11 () -> (networks :List(SavedWifiNetwork>);

    # Ethernet
    getEthernet @12 () -> (ethernet :EthernetInfo);

    # IP addresses
    getIp @13 () -> (ip :IpInfo);
    getPublicIp @14 () -> (ip :Text);

    # DNS
    getDns @15 () -> (dns :DnsInfo);
    setDns @16 (servers :List(Text)) -> T.VoidResult;
    resolve @17 (hostname :Text) -> (addresses :List(Text));
    flushDns @18 () -> T.VoidResult;

    # Routes
    getRoutes @19 () -> (routes :List(RouteInfo));
    addRoute @20 (route :RouteInfo) -> T.VoidResult;
    removeRoute @21 (destination :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Firewall
    getFirewall @22 () -> (firewall :FirewallInfo);
    listFirewallRules @23 () -> (rules :List(FirewallRule));
    addFirewallRule @24 (rule :FirewallRule) -> T.VoidResult;
    removeFirewallRule @25 (ruleId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    setFirewall @26 (enabled :Bool) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Bandwidth / traffic
    getBandwidth @27 () -> (bandwidth :BandwidthInfo);
    getTraffic @28 (interface :Text) -> (traffic :TrafficInfo>;

    # Connections
    listConnections @29 () -> (connections :List(ConnectionInfo));
    listListeningPorts @30 () -> (ports :List(ListeningPort>);

    # Ping / speed
    ping @31 (host :Text, count :UInt32) -> (result :PingResult);
    speedTest @32 () -> (result :SpeedTestResult);

    # Proxy
    getProxy @33 () -> (proxy :ProxyInfo);
    setProxy @34 (proxy :ProxyInfo) -> T.VoidResult;

    # VPN (see tunnel.capnp for tunnels)

    # Events
    subscribe @35 () -> (subscription :NetworkSubscription);
}

struct NetworkInfo {
    connected @0 :Bool;
    type @1 :Text;              # "wifi", "ethernet", "both"
    interfaces @2 :List(InterfaceInfo);
    wifi @3 :WifiInfo;
    ethernet @4 :EthernetInfo;
    ip @5 :IpInfo;
    dns @6 :DnsInfo;
    bandwidth @7 :BandwidthInfo;
    firewall @8 :FirewallInfo;
    proxy @9 :ProxyInfo;
}

struct InterfaceInfo {
    name @0 :Text;
    type @1 :InterfaceType;
    state @2 :InterfaceState;
    macAddress @3 :Text;
    mtu @4 :UInt32;
    ipAddresses @5 :List(Text);
    linkSpeed @6 :UInt64;       # Mbps
    # Bytes transferred.
    bytesReceived @7 :UInt64;
    bytesSent @8 :UInt64;
    # Whether this is the default route.
    defaultRoute @9 :Bool;
}

enum InterfaceType {
    wifi @0;
    ethernet @1;
    loopback @2;
    bridge @3;
    vlan @4;
    tunnel @5;
    virtual @6;
    custom @7;
}

enum InterfaceState {
    up @0;
    down @1;
    connecting @2;
    disconnected @3;
    error @4;
}

struct WifiInfo {
    enabled @0 :Bool;
    connected @1 :Bool;
    ssid @2 :Text;
    signal @3 :Float32;         # 0.0-1.0
    signalDbm @4 :Int32;        # dBm
    frequency @5 :UInt64;       # MHz
    speed @6 :UInt64;           # Mbps
    security @7 :Text;          # "WPA3", "WPA2", "Open"
    bssid @8 :Text;
    channel @9 :UInt32;
    band @10 :Text;             # "2.4GHz", "5GHz", "6GHz"
}

struct WifiNetwork {
    ssid @0 :Text;
    signal @1 :Float32;
    signalDbm @2 :Int32;
    frequency @3 :UInt64;
    security @4 :Text;
    channel @5 :UInt32;
    band @6 :Text;
    saved @7 :Bool;
}

struct SavedWifiNetwork {
    ssid @0 :Text;
    lastConnected @1 :T.Timestamp;
    autoConnect @2 :Bool;
}

enum ConnectResult {
    success @0;
    failed @1;
    timeout @2;
    wrongPassword @3;
    notFound @4;
    alreadyConnected @5;
    custom @6;
}

struct EthernetInfo {
    connected @0 :Bool;
    speed @1 :UInt64;           # Mbps
    duplex @2 :Text;            # "full", "half"
    linkDetected @3 :Bool;
}

struct IpInfo {
    ipv4 @0 :List(Text);
    ipv6 @1 :List(Text);
    gateway @2 :Text;
    publicIp @3 :Text;
}

struct DnsInfo {
    servers @0 :List(Text);
    # Whether DNS-over-HTTPS is enabled.
    doh @1 :Bool;
    dohServer @2 :Text;
    # Whether DNS-over-TLS is enabled.
    dot @3 :Bool;
    dotServer @4 :Text;
}

struct RouteInfo {
    destination @0 :Text;
    gateway @1 :Text;
    interface @2 :Text;
    metric @3 :UInt32;
    # Whether this is the default route.
    default @4 :Bool;
}

struct FirewallInfo {
    enabled @0 :Bool;
    defaultPolicy @1 :Text;     # "allow", "deny"
    ruleCount @2 :UInt32;
}

struct FirewallRule {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    direction @2 :FirewallDirection;
    action @3 :FirewallAction;
    protocol @4 :Text;          # "tcp", "udp", "icmp", "any"
    sourceAddress @5 :Text;
    sourcePort @6 :Text;
    destinationAddress @7 :Text;
    destinationPort @8 :Text;
    interface @9 :Text;
    enabled @10 :Bool;
    # Number of times this rule was hit.
    hitCount @11 :UInt64;
}

enum FirewallDirection {
    inbound @0;
    outbound @1;
    both @2;
}

enum FirewallAction {
    allow @0;
    deny @1;
    reject @2;
    log @3;
    custom @4;
}

struct BandwidthInfo {
    # Current rates.
    downloadBytesPerSec @0 :UInt64;
    uploadBytesPerSec @1 :UInt64;
    # Total since boot.
    totalDownloadBytes @2 :UInt64;
    totalUploadBytes @3 :UInt64;

struct InterfaceBandwidth {

}

struct TrafficInfo {

struct ConnectionInfo {

struct ListeningPort {

interface BluetoothService {

    # Devices
    listDevices @2 (filter :DeviceFilter) -> (devices :List(BluetoothDevice));
    getDevice @3 (deviceId :Text) -> (device :BluetoothDevice);

    # Pairing
    pair @5 (deviceId :Text) -> (result :PairResult);
    unpair @6 (deviceId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Connection
    connect @7 (deviceId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    disconnect @8 (deviceId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    disconnectAll @9 () -> T.VoidResult;

    # Profiles
    listProfiles @10 (deviceId :Text) -> (profiles :List(BtProfile));

    # GATT (BLE)
    listGattServices @11 (deviceId :Text) -> (services :List(GattService));
    readCharacteristic @12 (deviceId :Text, serviceId :Text, charId :Text) -> (data :Data);
    writeCharacteristic @13 (deviceId :Text, serviceId :Text, charId :Text, data :Data) -> T.VoidResult;
    subscribeCharacteristic @14 (deviceId :Text, serviceId :Text, charId :Text) -> (subscription :GattSubscription);

    # Advertising (BLE)
    startAdvertising @15 (config :AdvertiseConfig) -> T.VoidResult;
    stopAdvertising @16 () -> T.VoidResult;

    # Audio
    listAudioDevices @17 () -> (devices :List(AudioDevice));
    setActiveAudio @18 (deviceId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Events
    subscribe @19 () -> (subscription :BluetoothSubscription);

enum PairResult {

struct BtProfile {

struct GattService {

using T = import "types.capnp";

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DNS — resolver configuration, cache, DNS-over-HTTPS/TLS,
#       custom records, and DNS statistics
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface DnsService {
    # Configuration
    getConfig @0 () -> (config :DnsConfig);
    setConfig @1 (config :DnsConfig) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Resolution
    resolve @2 (hostname :Text, type :RecordType) -> (records :List(DnsRecord));
    reverseLookup @3 (address :Text) -> (hostname :Text);

    # Cache
    getCache @4 (pagination :T.Pagination) -> (entries :List(CacheEntry), total :UInt32);
    flushCache @5 () -> T.VoidResult;
    getCacheStats @6 () -> (stats :CacheStats);

    # DoH / DoT
    getSecureDns @7 () -> (config :SecureDnsConfig);
    setSecureDns @8 (config :SecureDnsConfig) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Custom records
    listCustomRecords @9 () -> (records :List(DnsRecord));
    addCustomRecord @10 (record :DnsRecord) -> T.VoidResult;
    removeCustomRecord @11 (name :Text, type :RecordType) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Statistics
    getStats @12 () -> (stats :DnsStats);

    # Events
    subscribe @13 () -> (subscription :DnsSubscription);
}

struct DnsConfig {
    servers @0 :List(Text);
    searchDomains @1 :List(Text);
    # Default TTL for cached entries.
    defaultTtl @2 :UInt32;
    # Whether to use the system resolver.
    useSystemResolver @3 :Bool;
    # Timeout for DNS queries (ms).
    timeout @4 :UInt32;
    # Number of retries.
    retries @5 :UInt32;
}

enum RecordType {
    a @0;
    aaaa @1;
    cname @2;
    mx @3;
    txt @4;
    srv @5;
    ns @6;
    ptr @7;
    soa @8;
    any @9;
}

struct DnsRecord {
    name @0 :Text;
    type @1 :RecordType;
    value @2 :Text;
    ttl @3 :UInt32;
    priority @4 :UInt32;        # For MX, SRV
    # Source: "server", "cache", "custom".
    source @5 :Text;
}

struct CacheEntry {
    name @0 :Text;
    type @1 :RecordType;
    value @2 :Text;
    ttl @3 :UInt32;
    # Remaining TTL.
    remainingTtl @4 :UInt32;
    # When this entry was cached.
    cachedAt @5 :T.Timestamp;
    # Number of times this entry was served from cache.
    hitCount @6 :UInt64;
}

struct CacheStats {
    totalEntries @0 :UInt32;
    hitRate @1 :Float32;
    totalHits @2 :UInt64;
    totalMisses @3 :UInt64;
    # Memory used by cache.
    memoryBytes @4 :UInt64;
}

struct SecureDnsConfig {
    # DNS-over-HTTPS.
    dohEnabled @0 :Bool;
    dohServer @1 :Text;
    dohUrl @2 :Text;
    # DNS-over-TLS.
    dotEnabled @3 :Bool;
    dotServer @4 :Text;
    # Whether the secure connection is active.
    active @5 :Bool;
    # TLS version.
    tlsVersion @6 :Text;
}

struct DnsStats {
    totalQueries @0 :UInt64;
    successfulQueries @1 :UInt64;
    failedQueries @2 :UInt64;
    averageLatencyMs @3 :Float32;
    # Top queried domains.
    topDomains @4 :List(DomainQueryCount);
}

struct DomainQueryCount {
    domain @0 :Text;
    count @1 :UInt64;
}

interface DnsSubscription {
    pull @0 () -> (events :List(DnsEvent));
    cancel @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
}

struct DnsEvent {
    union {
        resolved @0 :DnsRecord;
        cacheHit @1 :Text;
        cacheMiss @2 :Text;
        serverChanged @3 :List(Text);
        secureDnsChanged @4 :SecureDnsConfig;
        custom @5 :Data;
    }
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Tunnel — VPN, SSH tunnels, WireGuard, port forwarding
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface TunnelService {
    # List / get
    listTunnels @0 (filter :TunnelFilter) -> (tunnels :List(TunnelInfo));
    getTunnel @1 (tunnelId :Text) -> (tunnel :TunnelInfo);

    # Lifecycle
    create @2 (config :TunnelConfig) -> (tunnelId :Text);
    connect @3 (tunnelId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    disconnect @4 (tunnelId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    destroy @5 (tunnelId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Status
    getStatus @6 (tunnelId :Text) -> (status :TunnelStatus);

    # Presets
    listPresets @7 () -> (presets :List(TunnelPreset));
    connectPreset @8 (presetId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # Events
    subscribe @9 () -> (subscription :TunnelSubscription);
}

struct TunnelInfo {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    type @2 :TunnelType;
    state @3 :TunnelState;
    config @4 :TunnelConfig;
    status @5 :TunnelStatus;
    createdAt @6 :T.Timestamp;
    connectedAt @7 :T.Timestamp;
    # Whether this tunnel auto-connects.
    autoConnect @8 :Bool;
}

enum TunnelType {
    wireguard @0;
    openvpn @1;
    ipsec @2;
    ssh @3;
    socks @4;
    http @5;
    custom @6;
}

enum TunnelState {
    disconnected @0;
    connecting @1;
    connected @2;
    disconnecting @3;
    error @4;
}

struct TunnelConfig {
    name @0 :Text;
    type @1 :TunnelType;
    # Remote endpoint.
    endpoint @2 :Text;
    # Local address.
    localAddress @3 :Text;
    # Remote address.
    remoteAddress @4 :Text;
    # Port.
    port @5 :UInt16;
    # Authentication.
    auth @6 :TunnelAuth;
    # DNS through tunnel.
    dnsThroughTunnel @7 :Bool;
    # Kill switch (block traffic if tunnel drops).
    killSwitch @8 :Bool;
    # Allowed IPs (for WireGuard).
    allowedIps @9 :List(Text);
    # Auto-connect.
    autoConnect @10 :Bool;
    # Specific interface to bind to.
    bindInterface @11 :Text;
}

struct TunnelAuth {
    union {
        key @0 :Data;           # Private key
        certificate @1 :Text;   # Certificate path
        password @2 :Text;      # Password
        token @3 :Text;         # Auth token
        custom @4 :Data;
    }
}

struct TunnelStatus {
    state @0 :TunnelState;
    # Bytes transferred.
    bytesReceived @1 :UInt64;
    bytesSent @2 :UInt64;
    # Current throughput.
    downloadBps @3 :UInt64;
    uploadBps @4 :UInt64;
    # Latency to tunnel endpoint.
    latencyMs @5 :Float32;
    # Public IP through tunnel.
    publicIp @6 :Text;
    # How long connected.
    connectedDuration @7 :T.Duration;
    # Last handshake (WireGuard).
    lastHandshake @8 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct TunnelPreset {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    description @2 :Text;
    type @3 :TunnelType;
    endpoint @4 :Text;
    # Country / region.
    region @5 :Text;
    # Current load.
    load @6 :Float32;
}

struct TunnelFilter {
    type @0 :TunnelType;
    state @1 :TunnelState;
    autoConnect @2 :T.BoolFilter;
}

interface TunnelSubscription {
    pull @0 () -> (events :List(TunnelEvent));
    cancel @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
}

struct TunnelEvent {
    union {
        connected @0 :TunnelInfo;
        disconnected @1 :Text;
        stateChanged @2 :TunnelStateChangedEvent;
        error @3 :TunnelErrorEvent;
        custom @4 :Data;
    }
}

struct TunnelStateChangedEvent {
    tunnelId @0 :Text;
    previous @1 :TunnelState;
    current @2 :TunnelState;
    timestamp @3 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct TunnelErrorEvent {
    tunnelId @0 :Text;
    error @1 :Text;
    timestamp @2 :T.Timestamp;
    # Whether auto-reconnect will be attempted.
    willRetry @3 :Bool;
}

using T = import "types.capnp";

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Discovery — mDNS, SSDP, service advertisement, peer discovery
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface DiscoveryService {
    # Scan for services
    scan @0 (protocol :DiscoveryProtocol, duration :T.Duration) -> (services :List(DiscoveredService));

    # List previously discovered services
    listServices @1 (filter :ServiceFilter) -> (services :List(DiscoveredService));

    # Advertise a service
    advertise @2 (service :ServiceAdvertisement) -> T.VoidResult;
    stopAdvertising @3 (serviceId :Text) -> T.VoidResult;

    # List advertised services
    listAdvertised @4 () -> (services :List(ServiceAdvertisement));

    # Smart-protocol peer discovery
    discoverPeers @5 (duration :T.Duration) -> (peers :List(PeerInfo));
    listPeers @6 () -> (peers :List(PeerInfo));

    # Events
    subscribe @7 (protocol :DiscoveryProtocol) -> (subscription :DiscoverySubscription);
}

enum DiscoveryProtocol {
    mdns @0;
    ssdp @1;
    dnsSd @2;
    smartProtocol @3;       # smart-protocol native discovery
    all @4;
}

struct DiscoveredService {
    name @0 :Text;
    type @1 :Text;              # "_http._tcp", "_ssh._tcp", etc.
    protocol @2 :DiscoveryProtocol;
    host @3 :Text;
    port @4 :UInt16;
    addresses @5 :List(Text);
    txtRecords @6 :T.StringMap;
    # When first discovered.
    discoveredAt @7 :T.Timestamp;
    # Whether the service is still reachable.
    reachable @8 :Bool;
    # Latency.
    latencyMs @9 :Float32;
}

struct ServiceAdvertisement {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    type @2 :Text;
    port @3 :UInt16;
    txtRecords @4 :T.StringMap;
    # TTL.
    ttl @5 :UInt32;
    # Whether currently advertising.
    active @6 :Bool;
}

struct PeerInfo {
    id @0 :Text;
    name @1 :Text;
    hostname @2 :Text;
    addresses @3 :List(Text);
    # Protocol version.
    protocolVersion @4 :T.Version;
    # Capabilities.
    capabilities @5 :List(Text);
    # Last seen.
    lastSeen @6 :T.Timestamp;
    # Latency.
    latencyMs @7 :Float32;
}

struct ServiceFilter {
    protocol @0 :DiscoveryProtocol;
    type @1 :Text;
    reachable @2 :T.BoolFilter;
}

interface DiscoverySubscription {
    pull @0 () -> (events :List(DiscoveryEvent));
    cancel @1 () -> T.VoidResult;
}

struct DiscoveryEvent {
    union {
        serviceFound @0 :DiscoveredService;
        serviceLost @1 :Text;
        peerFound @2 :PeerInfo;
        peerLost @3 :Text;
        custom @4 :Data;
    }
}

CLI Methods: Batch 4
bashbash# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  BATCH 4: NETWORKING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── NETWORK ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Brief summary (bare word)
network
# Output:
#   🌐 Network
#   ├─ WiFi      ◉ "HomeNetwork"  78% (-52 dBm)  867 Mbps  WPA3
#   ├─ Ethernet  ✗ Disconnected
#   ├─ IP        192.168.1.42
#   ├─ DNS       1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8
#   └─ Bandwidth 2.3 MB/s ↓  0.1 MB/s ↑

# Full info
network info                        → full network details

# Interfaces
network interfaces                  → list all interfaces
network interface wlan0             → specific interface
network interface wlan0 info        → full interface details
network interface wlan0 enable      → enable interface
network interface wlan0 disable     → disable interface

# WiFi
network wifi                        → WiFi status
network wifi on                     → enable WiFi
network wifi off                    → disable WiFi
network wifi scan                   → scan for networks
network wifi connect "HomeNetwork"  → connect (prompts for password)
network wifi connect "HomeNetwork" "password123"  → connect with password
network wifi disconnect             → disconnect
network wifi forget "OldNetwork"    → forget saved network
network wifi saved                  → list saved networks
network wifi signal                 → signal strength
network wifi speed                  → connection speed
network wifi security               → security type

# Ethernet
network ethernet                    → ethernet status
network ethernet info               → ethernet details

# IP
network ip                          → all IP addresses
network ip4                         → IPv4 only
network ip6                         → IPv6 only
network gateway                     → default gateway
network public-ip                   → public IP address

# DNS
network dns                         → DNS servers
network dns set 1.1.1.1 8.8.8.8    → set DNS servers
network dns resolve example.com     → resolve hostname
network dns flush                   → flush DNS cache
network dns cache                   → show DNS cache
network dns cache stats             → cache hit/miss stats

# DNS-over-HTTPS / DNS-over-TLS
network dns secure                  → secure DNS status
network dns doh on                  → enable DNS-over-HTTPS
network dns doh off                 → disable DNS-over-HTTPS
network dns doh server "https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query"  → set DoH server
network dns dot on                  → enable DNS-over-TLS
network dns dot off                 → disable DNS-over-TLS

# Routes
network routes                      → routing table
network route add 10.0.0.0/8 192.168.1.1  → add route
network route remove 10.0.0.0/8    → remove route

# Firewall
network firewall                    → firewall status
network firewall on                 → enable firewall
network firewall off                → disable firewall
network firewall rules              → list firewall rules
network firewall rule add           → add rule (interactive)
network firewall rule add --direction inbound --action deny --port 22  → deny SSH inbound
network firewall rule remove <id>   → remove rule

# Bandwidth
network bandwidth                   → current bandwidth
network traffic                     → total traffic since boot
network traffic wlan0               → traffic for interface

# Connections
network connections                 → all active connections
network connections where remote-port == 443  → HTTPS connections
network ports                       → listening ports
network port 80                     → who's listening on port 80

# Ping / Speed
network ping google.com             → ping (default 4 packets)
network ping google.com --count 10  → ping 10 times
network speed                       → speed test
network traceroute google.com       → traceroute
network whois example.com           → whois lookup

# Proxy
network proxy                       → proxy status
network proxy on                    → enable proxy
network proxy off                   → disable proxy
network proxy set http proxy.local 3128  → set proxy
network proxy bypass "localhost,127.0.0.1"  → set bypass list

# Events
watch network                       → stream network events
watch network bandwidth             → stream bandwidth
watch network wifi                  → stream WiFi events
watch network connections           → stream connection events

# ── BLUETOOTH ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Brief summary (bare word)
bluetooth
# Output:
#   📶 Bluetooth
#   ├─ State     On
#   ├─ Address   AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF
#   ├─ Paired    3 devices
#   ├─ Connected 2 devices
#   └─ Discoverable Yes

# Full info
bluetooth info                      → full Bluetooth details

# Power
bluetooth on                        → enable Bluetooth
bluetooth off                       → disable Bluetooth

# Scanning
bluetooth scan                      → scan for devices
bluetooth scan --duration 30s       → scan for 30 seconds

# Devices
bluetooth devices                   → list all known devices
bluetooth devices where paired      → paired devices
bluetooth devices where connected   → connected devices
bluetooth device <id>               → device summary
bluetooth device <id> info          → full device info

# Pairing
bluetooth pair <id>                 → pair with device
bluetooth unpair <id>               → unpair device

# Connection
bluetooth connect <id>              → connect to device
bluetooth disconnect <id>           → disconnect
bluetooth disconnect-all            → disconnect all

# Profiles
bluetooth device <id> profiles      → list profiles for device

# GATT (BLE)
bluetooth device <id> gatt          → list GATT services
bluetooth device <id> gatt <svc-id> read <char-id>  → read characteristic
bluetooth device <id> gatt <svc-id> write <char-id> "data"  → write
bluetooth device <id> gatt <svc-id> subscribe <char-id>  → subscribe

# Advertising (BLE)
bluetooth advertise start --name "MyDevice" --services "uuid1,uuid2"  → start
bluetooth advertise stop            → stop

# Audio
bluetooth audio                     → list audio devices
bluetooth audio <id>                → audio device info
bluetooth audio <id> activate       → set as active audio

# Settings
bluetooth discoverable on           → make discoverable
bluetooth discoverable off          → hide
bluetooth name "My Laptop"          → set Bluetooth name

# Events
watch bluetooth                     → stream Bluetooth events
watch bluetooth devices             → stream device events

# ── DNS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

dns info                            → full DNS config
dns servers                         → DNS servers
dns set 1.1.1.1 8.8.8.8            → set DNS servers
dns resolve example.com             → resolve hostname
dns resolve example.com --type aaaa → resolve IPv6
dns reverse 1.1.1.1                 → reverse lookup
dns cache                           → show cache
dns cache flush                     → flush cache
dns cache stats                     → cache statistics
dns secure                          → secure DNS status
dns doh on                          → enable DNS-over-HTTPS
dns doh server "https://..."        → set DoH server
dns dot on                          → enable DNS-over-TLS
dns custom                          → list custom records
dns custom add my.local 192.168.1.5  → add custom record
dns custom remove my.local          → remove custom record
dns stats                           → DNS query statistics
dns stats top-domains               → most queried domains

# Events
watch dns                           → stream DNS events

# ── TUNNELS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# List (plural = list)
tunnels                             → list all tunnels
tunnels where state == connected    → connected tunnels
tunnels where type == wireguard     → WireGuard tunnels

# Single tunnel
tunnel <id>                         → tunnel summary
tunnel <id> info                    → full tunnel info

# Lifecycle
tunnel create --name "work-vpn" --type wireguard --endpoint "vpn.work.com:51820"  → create
tunnel connect <id>                 → connect
tunnel disconnect <id>              → disconnect
tunnel destroy <id>                 → destroy tunnel

# Presets
tunnel presets                      → list presets
tunnel preset <id>                  → connect to preset

# Events
watch tunnels                       → stream tunnel events

# ── WEBSOCKETS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

web get "https://api.example.com/data"  → HTTP GET
web post "https://api.example.com" '{"key":"value"}'  → HTTP POST
web download "https://file.zip" ~/file.zip  → download file
web ws "ws://localhost:8080"        → WebSocket connection

# ── DISCOVERY ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# List (plural = list)
discovery                           → list discovered services
discovery scan                      → scan all protocols
discovery scan --protocol mdns      → scan mDNS only
discovery scan --protocol ssdp      → scan SSDP only
discovery scan --duration 30s       → scan for 30s

# Specific protocol
discovery mdns                      → mDNS services
discovery ssdp                      → SSDP services

# Advertising
discovery advertise --name "MyService" --type "_http._tcp" --port 8080  → advertise
discovery advertise stop <id>       → stop advertising
discovery advertised                → list advertised services

# Peer discovery (smart-protocol)
discovery peers                     → list smart-protocol peers
discovery peers scan                → scan for peers

# Events
watch discovery                     → stream discovery events

# ── SOCKETS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

socket info                         → socket statistics
socket list                         → list all sockets
socket list where state == listen   → listening sockets
socket list where protocol == tcp   → TCP sockets
socket list where port == 80        → port 80 sockets

Schema Changes (blocks only)
Window ID System — NEW
The current WindowId is just a UInt32. That's fragile for real use. Change:
capnpcapnp# In types.capnp — replace WindowId

struct WindowId {
    union {
        number @0 :UInt32;          # Fast positional ID
        text @1 :Text;              # Human-readable title/app match
        hash @2 :Text;              # 6+ hex char deterministic hash
    }
}
Why: Numbers are ambiguous when you have 30 windows open. window 3 means nothing. Text IDs let you say window "Terminal — ~/Projects" or window Terminal (fuzzy). Hash IDs (#a3f2b1) are deterministic per session, computed from (appId + pid + creationTimestamp), stable even when title changes, and short enough to type.
Resolution order: hash (#…) > exact text > number > fuzzy text match
In all listings, show all three:
texttext  ┌─────┬──────────┬──────────────────────────────┬──────────┬────────┐
  │ #   │ Hash     │ Title                        │ App      │ State  │
  ├─────┼──────────┼──────────────────────────────┼──────────┼────────┤
  │  3  │ #a3f2b1  │ ~/Projects                   │ Terminal │ ◉ Focus│
  │  7  │ #c8d1e2  │ Inbox — Thunderbird          │ Mail     │ ○      │
  │ 12  │ #f7a003  │ YouTube — Firefox            │ Firefox  │ ○      │
  └─────┴──────────┴──────────────────────────────┴──────────┴────────┘
WindowFilter — ADD text and hash fields
capnpcapnp# Add to existing WindowFilter:
struct WindowFilter {
    # ... existing fields ...
    hashId @7 :Text;           # Filter by hash
    textId @8 :Text;           # Filter by exact or fuzzy title
    nth @9 :UInt32;            # Nth match when ambiguous (default: 1)
}
Tunnel missing fields — ADD to TunnelConfig
capnpcapnp# Add to TunnelConfig:
    # DNS servers to use through tunnel.
    dnsServers @12 :List(Text);
    # Pre-shared key (WireGuard).
    preSharedKey @13 :Data;
    # Persistent keepalive (WireGuard, seconds).
    keepalive @14 :UInt32;
    # Config file path (for import/export).
    configPath @15 :Text;
Firewall missing fields — ADD to FirewallRule
capnpcapnp# Add to FirewallRule:
    # Rate limit (e.g., "10/minute").
    rateLimit @12 :Text;
    # Log prefix for matched packets.
    logPrefix @13 :Text;
    # Expiration time.
    expiresAt @14 :T.Timestamp;
    # Priority (lower = higher priority).
    priority @15 :UInt32;
Discovery — fix import syntax error
capnpcapnp# discovery.capnp line 1 — was wrong, should be:
@0xa1b2c3d4e5f60064;
Auth — ADD missing methods to interface
capnpcapnp# Add to AuthService interface:
    changePassword @18 (oldPassword :Text, newPassword :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    whoami @19 () -> (user :UserInfo);
    getAuditLog @20 (pagination :T.Pagination) -> (entries :List(AuthAuditEntry), total :UInt32);

struct UserInfo {
    userId @0 :Text;
    username @1 :Text;
    displayName @2 :Text;
    email @3 :Text;
    roles @4 :List(Text);
    groups @5 :List(Text);
    createdAt @6 :T.Timestamp;
    lastLogin @7 :T.Timestamp;
}

struct AuthAuditEntry {
    id @0 :UInt64;
    action @1 :Text;
    userId @2 :Text;
    ip @3 :Text;
    result @4 :Bool;
    timestamp @5 :T.Timestamp;
    details @6 :Text;
}
Bluetooth — ADD missing fields to BluetoothDevice
capnpcapnp# Add to BluetoothDevice:
    # Whether device is blocked.
    blocked @14 :Bool;
    # Alias set by user.
    alias @15 :Text;          # (already in schema, ensure present)
    # Connection priority.
    priority @16 :UInt32;
    # Auto-connect.
    autoConnect @17 :Bool;
Network — ADD missing fields
capnpcapnp# Add to WifiNetwork:
    # Whether network requires captive portal login.
    captivePortal @8 :Bool;

# Add to NetworkService:
    getHostname @36 () -> (hostname :Text);
    setHostname @37 (hostname :Text) -> T.VoidResult;
    detectCaptivePortal @38 () -> (result :CaptivePortalResult);
    setMtu @39 (interface :Text, mtu :UInt32) -> T.VoidResult;

struct CaptivePortalResult {
    detected @0 :Bool;
    portalUrl @1 :Text;
    loginRequired @2 :Bool;
}
That's all schema changes. Everything else is already correct.

Window Reference System
Every window command accepts all three ID forms. Every form works everywhere.
texttextSYNTAX                          RESOLVES TO
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window 3                        By numeric ID (fast)
window #a3f2b1                  By hash prefix (exact)
window "Terminal — ~/Projects"  By exact title
window Terminal                 By fuzzy title match
window Terminal --nth 2         2nd Terminal match
window --app firefox            All Firefox windows
window --focused                Currently focused window

WHEREVER a window ID is accepted, ALL forms work:
  window 3 focus
  window #a3f2b1 focus
  window "Terminal" focus
  window Terminal focus
  window 3 snap left
  window #a3f2b1 snap left
  window 3 workspace 2
  window #a3f2b1 workspace 2
  window 3 close
  window "YouTube — Firefox" close

CLI Methods — Batch 2: Display & UI
display
bashbash# ── BARE WORD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
display
# Brief formatted summary (no info verb needed):
#   🖥 Display
#   ├─ Brightness   ████████░░░░  65%
#   ├─ Night Light   ✗ Off (6500K)
#   ├─ Dark Mode     ◉ On

# ── INFO ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
display info
  → Full display state. All monitors, all settings, all capabilities.

# ── BRIGHTNESS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
display brightness
  → Current brightness percentage.
display brightness 80
  → Set brightness to 80%.
display brightness +10
  → Increase by 10%.
display brightness -10
  → Decrease by 10%.
display brightness +1
  → Fine-grained increase.
display brightness min
  → Minimum brightness (5%).
display brightness max
  → Maximum brightness (100%).
display brightness --output eDP-1 65
  → Set brightness on specific monitor (if supported).

# ── NIGHT LIGHT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
display night-light
  → Night light status (enabled, temperature, schedule, active).
display night-light on
  → Enable night light at current temperature.
display night-light off
  → Disable night light.
display night-light temp 3500
  → Set color temperature in Kelvin (1000–6500).
display night-light temp 6500
  → Reset to neutral (daylight).
display night-light schedule "20:00" "07:00"
  → Auto-enable 20:00 to 07:00.
display night-light schedule off
  → Remove schedule (always on when enabled).
display night-light schedule
  → Show current schedule.

  → Enable dark mode.
display dark-mode off
  → Disable dark mode.
display dark-mode toggle

screenlock (under access domain)
bashbash# Screen lock is accessed via the access domain. See Batch 3.
# Methods: access lock, access unlock, access lock-screen, etc.

CLI Methods — Batch 3: Security & Access
access
bashbash# ── BARE WORD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
access
#   🔒 Access
#   ├─ State     Unlocked
#   ├─ Method    Password + Biometric
#   ├─ Session   Active (3h 42m)
#   └─ Lockout   None (0 failed attempts)

access info
  → Full access state: lock, credentials, MFA, recovery, policy, lock screen.

# ── LOCK / UNLOCK ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
access lock
  → Lock device immediately.
access lock --reason user
  → Lock with reason tag.
access lock --reason idle
  → Lock with reason: idle timeout.
access lock --reason policy
  → Lock with reason: policy enforcement.
access lock --reason remote
  → Lock with reason: remote lock.
access unlock
  → Unlock device. Requires credential as argument:
access unlock --password "mypassword"
  → Unlock with password.
access unlock --pin "1234"
  → Unlock with PIN.
access unlock --biometric
  → Unlock with biometric (fingerprint/face).
access unlock --recovery-code "ABCD-1234"
  → Unlock with recovery code.

# ── STATE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
access locked
  → Returns true/false (for scripting).
access lock-reason
  → Why the device is locked (user, idle, policy, remote, boot, failure).
access lock-time
  → When the device was locked.
access session
  → Active session details.
access sessions
  → List all active sessions.
access session revoke 42
  → Revoke session by ID.
access session revoke-all --except-current
  → Revoke all sessions except current.

# ── LOCK METHOD ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
access lock-method
  → Current lock method.
access lock-method password
  → Set to password only.
access lock-method pin
  → Set to PIN only.
access lock-method biometric
  → Set to biometric only.
access lock-method password+biometric
  → Set to password AND biometric.
access lock-method pin+biometric
  → Set to PIN AND biometric.

# ── LOCKOUT POLICY ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
access lockout-policy
  → Full lockout policy.
access lockout-policy set max-attempts 5
  → Max failed attempts before lockout.
access lockout-policy set lockout-duration 300
  → Lockout duration in seconds (0 = permanent until recovery).
access lockout-policy set cooldown 5
  → Cooldown between attempts in seconds.
access lockout-policy set wipe-after 10
  → Factory wipe after N consecutive failures (0 = disabled).
access lockout-policy set require-mfa-after 3
  → Require MFA after N failed password attempts.
access lockout-policy set max-consecutive-failures 20
  → Max consecutive failures before permanent lockout.

# ── CREDENTIALS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
access credentials
  → List all enrolled credentials (method, strength, last used, enrolled date).
access credential enroll password --password "newpassword"
  → Enroll password credential.
access credential enroll pin --pin "1234"
  → Enroll PIN.
access credential enroll biometric --type fingerprint
  → Enroll fingerprint.
access credential enroll biometric --type face
  → Enroll face.
access credential revoke 2
  → Revoke credential by ID.
access credential assess 1
  → Assess credential strength (entropy, common patterns, breach check).

# ── MFA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
access mfa
  → MFA status and enrolled factors.
access mfa enroll totp --secret "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP"
  → Enroll TOTP with secret.
access mfa enroll totp --qr ~/totp-qr.png
  → Enroll TOTP from QR code image.
access mfa enroll hardware-key --name "YubiKey"
  → Enroll hardware key.
access mfa enroll sms --phone "+1234567890"
  → Enroll SMS.
access mfa enroll email --email "user@example.com"
  → Enroll email OTP.
access mfa revoke 3
  → Revoke MFA factor by ID.
access mfa challenge
  → Request MFA challenge (returns challenge ID).
access mfa verify 3 "123456"
  → Verify MFA code for factor.
access mfa verify backup "ABCD-1234-EFGH"
  → Verify with backup code.
access mfa status
  → Current MFA challenge status (pending, expired, verified).

# ── RECOVERY ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
access recovery
  → Recovery status and available methods.
access recovery start
  → Start recovery flow (returns recovery session ID).
access recovery codes
  → List recovery codes (masked: ABCD-****-EFGH).
access recovery codes --reveal
  → List recovery codes (full, requires auth).
access recovery codes generate 10
  → Generate 10 new recovery codes. Old codes invalidated.
access recovery submit "ABCD-1234-EFGH"
  → Submit recovery code.
access recovery methods
  → List available recovery methods (recovery code, backup credential, admin).

# ── BACKUP CREDENTIALS ──────────────────────────────────────────────
access backups
  → List backup credentials.
access backup enroll --type hardware-key --name "Backup YubiKey"
  → Enroll backup credential.
access backup revoke 5
  → Revoke backup credential.
access backup rotate 5
  → Rotate backup credential (issue new, revoke old).
access backup uses 5
  → Show remaining uses for backup credential.

# ── POLICY ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
access policy
  → Full lock policy.
access policy lock-on-suspend on
  → Lock on suspend.
access policy lock-on-suspend off
  → Don't lock on suspend.
access policy lock-on-boot on
  → Lock on boot (require auth at startup).
access policy lock-on-boot off
  → Don't lock on boot.
access policy show-notifications on
  → Show notifications on lock screen.
access policy show-notifications off
  → Hide notifications on lock screen.
access policy media-controls on
  → Allow media controls on lock screen.
access policy media-controls off
  → Disable media controls on lock screen.
access policy require-auth-on-wake on
  → Require auth to wake from blank screen.
access policy require-auth-on-wake off
  → Don't require auth to wake.
access policy grace-period 10
  → Grace period in seconds (0 = immediate lock).
access policy grace-period 0
  → No grace period.
access policy idle-lock on 300
  → Auto-lock after 300 seconds idle.
access policy idle-lock off
  → Disable idle lock.

# ── LOCK SCREEN ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
access lock-screen
  → Lock screen configuration.
access lock-screen wallpaper ~/lock.jpg
  → Set lock screen wallpaper.
access lock-screen wallpaper default
  → Reset to default wallpaper.
access lock-screen clock on
  → Show clock on lock screen.
access lock-screen clock off
  → Hide clock.
access lock-screen date on
  → Show date on lock screen.
access lock-screen date off
  → Hide date.
access lock-screen battery on
  → Show battery on lock screen.
access lock-screen battery off
  → Hide battery.
access lock-screen notifications on
  → Show notification count (not content).
access lock-screen notifications off
  → Hide notification count.
access lock-screen message "Welcome back!"
  → Set lock screen message.
access lock-screen message ""
  → Clear lock screen message.
access lock-screen font "Cantarell"
  → Set lock screen font.

# ── BACKEND ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
access backends
  → List available security backends (tpm, software, smartcard).
access backend
  → Active backend.

  → Set TPM backend.

  → Set software backend.

  → Last 24 hours.

  → Last 7 days.

  → Only lock events.

  → Only failed attempts.

  → Last 50 entries.

  → Detached signature (separate .sig file).
signature sign ~/app.bin --key <key-id> --embedded
  → Embedded signature.
signature verify ~/app.bin
  → Verify binary (auto-detect signature).
signature verify ~/app.bin --signature ~/app.bin.sig
  → Verify with detached signature.
signature verify ~/app.bin --verbose
  → Verify with full chain output.

# ── TRUST STORE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
signature trust
  → List all trusted keys.
signature trust where level == ultimate
  → Ultimate trust only.
signature trust where source == vendor
  → Vendor keys only.
signature trust add ~/vendor-key.pem
  → Add trusted key.
signature trust add ~/vendor-key.pem --level high --name "Vendor CA"
  → Add with trust level and name.
signature trust remove <id>
  → Remove trusted key.
signature trust set <id> --level high
  → Change trust level.

# ── TRUST CHAIN ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
signature chain ~/app.bin
  → Show trust chain for signed binary.
signature chain verify <key-id>
  → Verify trust chain for key.

# ── POLICY ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
signature policy
  → Full signing policy.
signature policy require on
  → Require all binaries to be signed.
signature policy require off
  → Don't require signatures.
signature policy min-trust high
  → Minimum trust level (unknown, low, medium, high, ultimate).
signature policy check-revocation on
  → Check certificate revocation.
signature policy check-revocation off
  → Don't check revocation.
signature policy require-timestamp on
  → Require timestamps.
signature policy require-timestamp off
  → Don't require timestamps.
signature policy allowed-algorithms "ed25519,ecdsa-p256,rsa-pss"
  → Set allowed algorithms.
signature policy block-unsigned on
  → Block execution of unsigned binaries.
signature policy block-unsigned off
  → Allow unsigned binaries.

# ── AUDIT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
signature audit
  → Signing audit log.
signature audit --since 24h
  → Last 24 hours.
signature audit --action sign
  → Sign events.
signature audit --action verify
  → Verify events.
signature audit --action key-add
  → Key addition events.
signature audit --action key-remove
  → Key removal events.
signature audit --result failed
  → Failed operations.
signature audit 50
  → Last 50 entries.

# ── EVENTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
watch signature
  → Stream signature events.
watch signature policy
  → Stream policy changes.

  → Cross-domain: display + audio + bluetooth + network + notifications.
prepare presentation
  → Cross-domain: display + audio + notifications + compositor.
prepare night
  → Cross-domain: display + power + notifications + bluetooth.
prepare privacy
  → Cross-domain: network + bluetooth + discovery + firewall.

# ── DEBUG ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
debug connection <host>
  → DNS + routing + firewall + ping + TLS.
debug wifi
  → WiFi adapter + signal + DHCP + gateway + DNS + interference.
debug bluetooth audio
  → Bluetooth + audio + codec + signal + battery.
debug display
  → Monitors + compositor + effects + accessibility.
debug dns <hostname>
  → DNS resolution + cache + server reachability.
debug tunnel <id>
  → Tunnel config + endpoint reachability + routing + kill switch.

# ── PRIVACY CHECK ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
privacy check
  → Network + DNS + proxy + VPN + firewall + bluetooth + discovery + open ports.

# ── DIAGNOSE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
diagnose
  → System-wide diagnostics across all domains.
diagnose --domain network
  → Network-only diagnostics.
diagnose --domain display
  → Display-only diagnostics.
diagnose --domain audio
  → Audio-only diagnostics.
diagnose --domain security
  → Security-only diagnostics.

# ── NETWORK ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Brief summary (bare word)
network
# Output:
#   🌐 Network
#   ├─ WiFi      ◉ "HomeNetwork"  78% (-52 dBm)  867 Mbps  WPA3
#   ├─ Ethernet  ✗ Disconnected
#   ├─ IP        192.168.1.42

# Full info
network info                        → full network details

# Interfaces
network interfaces                  → list all interfaces
network interface wlan0             → specific interface
network interface wlan0 info        → full interface details
network interface wlan0 enable      → enable interface
network interface wlan0 disable     → disable interface

# WiFi
network wifi                        → WiFi status
network wifi on                     → enable WiFi
network wifi off                    → disable WiFi
network wifi scan                   → scan for networks
network wifi connect "HomeNetwork"  → connect (prompts for password)
network wifi connect "HomeNetwork" "password123"  → connect with password
network wifi disconnect             → disconnect
network wifi forget "OldNetwork"    → forget saved network
network wifi saved                  → list saved networks
network wifi signal                 → signal strength
network wifi speed                  → connection speed
network wifi security               → security type

# Ethernet
network ethernet                    → ethernet status
network ethernet info               → ethernet details

# IP
network ip                          → all IP addresses
network ip4                         → IPv4 only
network ip6                         → IPv6 only
network gateway                     → default gateway
network public-ip                   → public IP address

# DNS
network dns                         → DNS servers
network dns set 1.1.1.1 8.8.8.8    → set DNS servers
network dns resolve example.com     → resolve hostname
network dns flush                   → flush DNS cache
network dns cache                   → show DNS cache
network dns cache stats             → cache hit/miss stats

# DNS-over-HTTPS / DNS-over-TLS
network dns secure                  → secure DNS status
network dns doh on                  → enable DNS-over-HTTPS
network dns doh off                 → disable DNS-over-HTTPS
network dns doh server "https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query"  → set DoH server
network dns dot on                  → enable DNS-over-TLS
network dns dot off                 → disable DNS-over-TLS

# Routes
network routes                      → routing table
network route add 10.0.0.0/8 192.168.1.1  → add route
network route remove 10.0.0.0/8    → remove route

# Firewall
network firewall                    → firewall status
network firewall on                 → enable firewall
network firewall off                → disable firewall
network firewall rules              → list firewall rules
network firewall rule add           → add rule (interactive)
network firewall rule add --direction inbound --action deny --port 22  → deny SSH inbound
network firewall rule remove <id>   → remove rule

# Bandwidth
network bandwidth                   → current bandwidth
network traffic                     → total traffic since boot
network traffic wlan0               → traffic for interface

# Connections
network connections                 → all active connections
network connections where remote-port == 443  → HTTPS connections
network ports                       → listening ports
network port 80                     → who's listening on port 80

# Ping / Speed
network ping google.com             → ping (default 4 packets)
network ping google.com --count 10  → ping 10 times
network speed                       → speed test
network traceroute google.com       → traceroute
network whois example.com           → whois lookup

# Proxy
network proxy                       → proxy status
network proxy on                    → enable proxy
network proxy off                   → disable proxy
network proxy set http proxy.local 3128  → set proxy
network proxy bypass "localhost,127.0.0.1"  → set bypass list

# Events
watch network                       → stream network events
watch network bandwidth             → stream bandwidth
watch network wifi                  → stream WiFi events
watch network connections           → stream connection events
